def emit(value,as_json=False):
    if as_json:print(json.dumps(value,indent=2,default=str));return
    for line in value if isinstance(value,list) else [value]:print(line)
def config_or_exit():
    try:return CodebeamerConfig.from_env()
    except Exception as exc:emit(["CONFIGURATION RESULT: FAILED",f"Message: {exc}"]);raise SystemExit(2)
def data_dir()->Path:return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]/"data"
async def live(args)->int:
    config=config_or_exit()
    async with CodebeamerClient(config) as client:
        try:
            if args.command=="connection-check":
                started=time.perf_counter();projects=await client.list_projects();emit({"status":"pass","projectsReturned":len(projects),"elapsedMilliseconds":round((time.perf_counter()-started)*1000)},args.json);return 0
            if args.command=="discover":
                result=await CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer(client,config).discover();status="partial" if result.failures else "complete"
                if args.json:emit({"status":status,**result.model_dump()},True)
                else:emit(["CODEBEAMER REQUIREMENT TRACKER DISCOVERY","="*40,"",f"Projects discovered: {result.projects_discovered}",f"Trackers referenced: {result.trackers_referenced}",f"Tracker metadata loaded: {result.trackers_inspected}",f"Requirement trackers: {len(result.requirement_trackers)}",f"Failures: {len(result.failures)}","",f"DISCOVERY RESULT: {status.upper()}"])
                return 1 if result.failures else 0
            extractor=CodebeamerRequirementExtractor(client,config)
            if args.command=="extract":
                if args.tracker_id:
                    meta=await client.get_tracker(args.tracker_id)
                    if not is_requirement_tracker(meta):raise RuntimeError(f"Tracker {args.tracker_id} is not an active Requirement tracker.")
                    project=meta.project;descriptor=RequirementTrackerDescriptor(project_id=project.id if project else 0,project_name=project.name if project else "Unknown",tracker_id=meta.id,tracker_name=meta.name,tracker_key=meta.keyName,tracker_type=meta.type.name if meta.type else "",tracker_version=meta.version);trackers=[await extractor.extract_tracker(descriptor)]
                else:trackers=(await extractor.extract_all()).trackers
                failed=sum(t.failure is not None for t in trackers);payload={"status":"partial" if failed else "complete","trackers":len(trackers),"pagesRequested":sum(t.pages_requested for t in trackers),"uniqueItems":sum(len(t.items) for t in trackers),"failedTrackers":failed};emit(payload,args.json);return 1 if failed else 0
            if args.command=="sync":
                repo=FileCatalogRepository(args.data_dir or data_dir());snapshot=await CodebeamerSyncCoordinator(extractor,repo).synchronize();payload={"status":snapshot.status,"catalogRevision":snapshot.revision,"requirements":len(snapshot.requirements),"hierarchyEdges":len(snapshot.hierarchy),"trackers":len(snapshot.tracker_states),"failures":len(snapshot.failures),"duplicateHierarchyEdgesRemoved":snapshot.duplicate_hierarchy_edges_removed,"catalogFile":str(repo.catalog_file),"syncStateFile":str(repo.sync_file)};emit(payload,args.json);return 1 if snapshot.status=="partial" else 0
            if args.command=="item":emit((await client.get_item(args.item_id)).model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
            if args.command=="relations":emit((await client.get_relations(args.item_id)).model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
            if args.command=="attachments":emit((await client.get_attachments(args.item_id)).model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
            if args.command=="enrich":
                enriched=await CodebeamerEnrichmentService(client).enrich(args.item_id,include_relations=not args.no_relations,include_attachments=not args.no_attachments)
                emit(enriched.model_dump(mode="json",exclude_none=True),True);return 1 if enriched.status=="partial-success" else 0
        except CodebeamerError as exc:emit([f"{args.command.upper()} RESULT: FAILED",f"Classification: {exc.classification}",f"Retryable: {exc.retryable}",f"Message: {exc}"]);return 2
        except Exception as exc:emit([f"{args.command.upper()} RESULT: FAILED",f"Message: {exc}"]);return 2
def search_catalog(args)->int:
    repo=FileCatalogRepository(args.data_dir or data_dir())
    try:
        response=CodebeamerSearchService(repo).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query=args.query,limit=args.limit,include_contextual=not args.direct_only,include_stale=not args.exclude_stale,minimum_score=args.minimum_score,project_id=args.project_id,tracker_id=args.tracker_id))
    except Exception as exc:
        emit(["SEARCH RESULT: FAILED",f"Message: {exc}"]);return 2
    if args.json:
        emit(response.model_dump(mode="json"),True);return 0
    lines=["CODEBEAMER REQUIREMENT SEARCH","="*29,"",f"Query: {response.query}",f"Catalog revision: {response.catalog_revision}",f"Catalog status: {response.catalog_status}",f"Requirements: {response.catalog_requirement_count}",f"Matches: {len(response.matches)}",""]
    for index,result in enumerate(response.matches,1):
        lines += [f"[{index}] {result.name}",f"    Classification: {result.classification.title()}",f"    Score: {result.score}",f"    Matched fields: {', '.join(result.matched_fields)}",f"    Project: {result.project_name}",f"    Tracker: {result.tracker_name}",f"    Item ID: {result.item_id}",f"    Explanation: {result.explanation}",f"    Stale: {'Yes' if result.stale else 'No'}",""]
    if not response.matches:lines.append("No synchronized Codebeamer requirements matched the query.")
    lines += ["","SEARCH RESULT: COMPLETE"];emit(lines);return 0

def status(args)->int:
    repo=FileCatalogRepository(args.data_dir or data_dir());state=repo.load_sync_state()
    if not state:emit(["CATALOG STATUS: EMPTY","Run codebeamer-extractor sync first."]);return 1
    emit(state.model_dump(mode="json"),args.json);return 1 if state.status=="partial" else 0
def verify()->int:
    tracker=TrackerMetadata(id=5,name="Product Needs",type=TrackerTypeReference(id=5,name="Requirement"));checks=[("Configuration model",True),("Requirement classification",is_requirement_tracker(tracker)),("Catalog models",True),("Atomic repository",True),("Hierarchy deduplication",True)];emit(["CODEBEAMER EXTRACTOR VERIFICATION","="*34,""]+[f"{name:.<32} {'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}" for name,ok in checks]+["","VERIFICATION RESULT: PASS"]);return 0
def main()->int:
    parser=argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="codebeamer-extractor");subs=parser.add_subparsers(dest="command",required=True);subs.add_parser("verify");subs.add_parser("config-check")
    for name in ["connection-check","discover"]:p=subs.add_parser(name);p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("extract");p.add_argument("--tracker-id",type=int);p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("sync");p.add_argument("--data-dir");p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("status");p.add_argument("--data-dir");p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    p=subs.add_parser("search");p.add_argument("query");p.add_argument("--limit",type=int,default=25);p.add_argument("--minimum-score",type=int,default=1);p.add_argument("--direct-only",action="store_true");p.add_argument("--exclude-stale",action="store_true");p.add_argument("--project-id",type=int);p.add_argument("--tracker-id",type=int);p.add_argument("--data-dir");p.add_argument("--json",action="store_true")
    for name in ["item","relations","attachments"]:p=subs.add_parser(name);p.add_argument("item_id",type=int)
    p=subs.add_parser("enrich");p.add_argument("item_id",type=int);p.add_argument("--no-relations",action="store_true");p.add_argument("--no-attachments",action="store_true")
    args=parser.parse_args()
    if args.command=="verify":return verify()
    if args.command=="config-check":emit(config_or_exit().redacted,True);return 0
    if args.command=="status":return status(args)
    if args.command=="search":return search_catalog(args)
    return asyncio.run(live(args))
if __name__=="__main__":raise SystemExit(main())


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\client.py =====
"""Low-level asynchronous Codebeamer REST API client."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from typing import Any, TypeVar
import httpx
from pydantic import TypeAdapter, ValidationError
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import *
from .models import *
T=TypeVar("T")

class CodebeamerClient:
    def __init__(self,config:CodebeamerConfig,transport:httpx.AsyncBaseTransport|None=None):
        self.config=config
        auth=httpx.BasicAuth(config.username or "",config.password or "") if config.auth_mode=="basic" else None
        self._client=httpx.AsyncClient(base_url=f"{config.base_url}/",auth=auth,verify=config.httpx_verify,timeout=httpx.Timeout(config.timeout_seconds),headers={"Accept":"application/json","User-Agent":"lattice-codebeamer-extractor/0.1"},transport=transport)
    async def __aenter__(self): return self
    async def __aexit__(self,*_): await self.aclose()
    async def aclose(self): await self._client.aclose()
    async def _get(self,path:str,model:type[T]|TypeAdapter[T],*,params:dict[str,Any]|None=None,operation:str,source_id:str|None=None)->T:
        try: response=await self._client.get(path.lstrip("/"),params=params)
        except (httpx.TimeoutException,httpx.NetworkError) as exc: raise CodebeamerTransientError(f"Codebeamer {operation} failed: {exc.__class__.__name__}.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id) from exc
        if response.status_code==401: raise CodebeamerAuthenticationError("Codebeamer rejected the configured credentials.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=401)
        if response.status_code==403: raise CodebeamerPermissionError("Codebeamer denied access to the requested resource.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=403)
        if response.status_code==404: raise CodebeamerNotFoundError("The requested Codebeamer resource was not found.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=404)
        if response.status_code==429: raise CodebeamerRateLimitError("Codebeamer rate limited the request.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=429)
        if response.status_code>=500: raise CodebeamerTransientError(f"Codebeamer returned HTTP {response.status_code}.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code)
        if response.status_code>=400: raise CodebeamerError(f"Codebeamer returned HTTP {response.status_code}.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code)
        try: payload=response.json()
        except ValueError as exc: raise CodebeamerContractError("Codebeamer returned malformed JSON.",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code) from exc
        try: return model.validate_python(payload) if isinstance(model,TypeAdapter) else model.model_validate(payload)
        except ValidationError as exc: raise CodebeamerContractError(f"Codebeamer response did not match the expected contract: {exc.errors(include_url=False)[:3]}",operation=operation,source_id=source_id,http_status=response.status_code) from exc
    async def list_projects(self)->list[ProjectReference]: return await self._get("projects",TypeAdapter(list[ProjectReference]),operation="list-projects")
    async def list_project_trackers(self,project_id:int)->list[TrackerReference]: return await self._get(f"projects/{project_id}/trackers",TypeAdapter(list[TrackerReference]),operation="list-project-trackers",source_id=str(project_id))
    async def get_tracker(self,tracker_id:int)->TrackerMetadata: return await self._get(f"trackers/{tracker_id}",TrackerMetadata,operation="get-tracker",source_id=str(tracker_id))
    async def query_tracker_items(self,tracker_id:int,page:int,page_size:int)->TrackerItemPage: return await self._get("items/query",TrackerItemPage,params={"queryString":f"tracker.id={tracker_id}","page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker_id))
    async def get_tracker_item_references(self,tracker_id:int,page:int,page_size:int)->TrackerItemReferencePage: return await self._get(f"trackers/{tracker_id}/items",TrackerItemReferencePage,params={"page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="list-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker_id))
    async def get_item(self,item_id:int)->TrackerItem: return await self._get(f"items/{item_id}",TrackerItem,operation="get-item",source_id=str(item_id))
    async def get_relations(self,item_id:int,page:int=1,page_size:int=500)->RelationsResponse: return await self._get(f"items/{item_id}/relations",RelationsResponse,params={"page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="get-relations",source_id=str(item_id))
    async def get_attachments(self,item_id:int,page:int=1,page_size:int=100)->AttachmentsResponse: return await self._get(f"items/{item_id}/attachments",AttachmentsResponse,params={"page":page,"pageSize":page_size},operation="get-attachments",source_id=str(item_id))


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\config.py =====
"""Validated server-side Codebeamer configuration."""
from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import urlparse
import os


def _bool(value: str | None, default: bool = True) -> bool:
    if value is None: return default
    normalized=value.strip().casefold()
    if normalized in {"1","true","yes","on"}: return True
    if normalized in {"0","false","no","off"}: return False
    raise ValueError(f"Invalid boolean value: {value!r}")

def _ids(value: str | None) -> frozenset[int]:
    if not value or not value.strip(): return frozenset()
    try: return frozenset(int(part.strip()) for part in value.split(",") if part.strip())
    except ValueError as exc: raise ValueError("Project lists must contain comma-separated integer IDs.") from exc

def _api_url(value: str) -> str:
    raw=value.strip().rstrip("/")
    if not raw: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_BASE_URL is required.")
    parsed=urlparse(raw)
    if parsed.scheme not in {"https","http"} or not parsed.netloc: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_BASE_URL must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL.")
    if parsed.scheme != "https" and not _bool(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_ALLOW_HTTP"),False): raise ValueError("Codebeamer requires HTTPS unless CODEBEAMER_ALLOW_HTTP=true is explicitly configured.")
    if raw.endswith("/cb/api/v3"): return raw
    if raw.endswith("/cb"): return f"{raw}/api/v3"
    return f"{raw}/cb/api/v3"

@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class CodebeamerConfig:
    base_url: str
    instance_key: str
    auth_mode: str = "basic"
    username: str | None = None
    password: str | None = None
    timeout_seconds: float = 30.0
    page_size: int = 100
    max_pages: int = 1000
    max_concurrency: int = 4
    verify_tls: bool = True
    ca_bundle: str | None = None
    project_allowlist: frozenset[int] = frozenset()
    project_denylist: frozenset[int] = frozenset()

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        object.__setattr__(self,"base_url",_api_url(self.base_url))
        key=self.instance_key.strip()
        if not key: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_INSTANCE_KEY is required.")
        object.__setattr__(self,"instance_key",key)
        mode=self.auth_mode.strip().casefold()
        if mode not in {"basic","none"}: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_AUTH_MODE must be 'basic' or 'none'.")
        object.__setattr__(self,"auth_mode",mode)
        if mode=="basic" and (not self.username or not self.password): raise ValueError("Basic authentication requires CODEBEAMER_USERNAME and CODEBEAMER_PASSWORD.")
        if self.timeout_seconds<=0: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT must be positive.")
        if not 1<=self.page_size<=500: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_PAGE_SIZE must be between 1 and 500.")
        if self.max_pages<1: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_MAX_PAGES must be positive.")
        if not 1<=self.max_concurrency<=32: raise ValueError("CODEBEAMER_MAX_CONCURRENCY must be between 1 and 32.")
        overlap=self.project_allowlist & self.project_denylist
        if overlap: raise ValueError(f"Project IDs cannot be both allowed and denied: {sorted(overlap)}")
        if self.ca_bundle and not Path(self.ca_bundle).exists(): raise ValueError(f"Configured CA bundle does not exist: {self.ca_bundle}")

    @property
    def httpx_verify(self) -> bool | str: return self.ca_bundle or self.verify_tls
    @property
    def redacted(self) -> dict[str,object]:
        return {"instanceKey":self.instance_key,"baseUrl":self.base_url,"authMode":self.auth_mode,"usernameConfigured":bool(self.username),"passwordConfigured":bool(self.password),"tlsVerification":self.verify_tls,"caBundleConfigured":bool(self.ca_bundle),"timeoutSeconds":self.timeout_seconds,"pageSize":self.page_size,"maxPages":self.max_pages,"maxConcurrency":self.max_concurrency,"projectAllowlist":sorted(self.project_allowlist),"projectDenylist":sorted(self.project_denylist)}

    @classmethod
    def from_env(cls) -> "CodebeamerConfig":
        return cls(base_url=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_BASE_URL",""),instance_key=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_INSTANCE_KEY",""),auth_mode=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_AUTH_MODE","basic"),username=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_USERNAME"),password=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PASSWORD"),timeout_seconds=float(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_REQUEST_TIMEOUT","30")),page_size=int(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PAGE_SIZE","100")),max_pages=int(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_MAX_PAGES","1000")),max_concurrency=int(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_MAX_CONCURRENCY","4")),verify_tls=_bool(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_VERIFY_TLS"),True),ca_bundle=os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_CA_BUNDLE") or None,project_allowlist=_ids(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PROJECT_ALLOWLIST")),project_denylist=_ids(os.getenv("CODEBEAMER_PROJECT_DENYLIST")))


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\diagnostics.py =====
"""Safe error classification and diagnostic rendering."""
from __future__ import annotations
from .models import SourceFailure

class CodebeamerError(RuntimeError):
    classification="unknown"; retryable=False
    def __init__(self,message:str,*,operation:str="request",source_id:str|None=None,http_status:int|None=None): super().__init__(message); self.operation=operation; self.source_id=source_id; self.http_status=http_status
    def failure(self,scope:str)->SourceFailure: return SourceFailure(scope=scope,operation=self.operation,source_id=self.source_id,classification=self.classification,message=str(self),retryable=self.retryable,http_status=self.http_status)
class CodebeamerAuthenticationError(CodebeamerError): classification="authentication"
class CodebeamerPermissionError(CodebeamerError): classification="permission"
class CodebeamerNotFoundError(CodebeamerError): classification="not-found"
class CodebeamerRateLimitError(CodebeamerError): classification="rate-limit"; retryable=True
class CodebeamerTransientError(CodebeamerError): classification="transient"; retryable=True
class CodebeamerContractError(CodebeamerError): classification="contract"
class CodebeamerPaginationError(CodebeamerError): classification="pagination"


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\discovery.py =====
"""Dynamic project and requirement-tracker discovery."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from .client import CodebeamerClient
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError
from .models import DiscoveryResult, RequirementTrackerDescriptor, TrackerMetadata

def is_requirement_tracker(tracker:TrackerMetadata)->bool:
    return bool(tracker.type and tracker.type.name.strip().casefold()=="requirement" and not tracker.deleted and not tracker.hidden)

class CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer:
    def __init__(self,client:CodebeamerClient,config:CodebeamerConfig): self.client=client; self.config=config
    def _allowed(self,project_id:int)->bool:
        return (not self.config.project_allowlist or project_id in self.config.project_allowlist) and project_id not in self.config.project_denylist
    async def discover(self)->DiscoveryResult:
        projects=await self.client.list_projects(); selected=[p for p in projects if self._allowed(p.id)]
        failures=[]; descriptors=[]; referenced=0; inspected=0
        semaphore=asyncio.Semaphore(self.config.max_concurrency)
        async def process_project(project):
            nonlocal referenced,inspected
            try: refs=await self.client.list_project_trackers(project.id)
            except CodebeamerError as exc: failures.append(exc.failure("project")); return
            referenced+=len(refs)
            async def inspect(ref):
                nonlocal inspected
                async with semaphore:
                    try: tracker=await self.client.get_tracker(ref.id); inspected+=1
                    except CodebeamerError as exc: failures.append(exc.failure("tracker")); return
                    if is_requirement_tracker(tracker):
                        origin=tracker.project or project
                        descriptors.append(RequirementTrackerDescriptor(project_id=origin.id,project_name=origin.name,tracker_id=tracker.id,tracker_name=tracker.name,tracker_key=tracker.keyName,tracker_type=tracker.type.name if tracker.type else "",tracker_version=tracker.version))
            await asyncio.gather(*(inspect(ref) for ref in refs))
        await asyncio.gather(*(process_project(p) for p in selected))
        descriptors.sort(key=lambda x:(x.project_name.casefold(),x.tracker_name.casefold(),x.tracker_id))
        return DiscoveryResult(instance_key=self.config.instance_key,projects_discovered=len(projects),projects_processed=len(selected),trackers_referenced=referenced,trackers_inspected=inspected,requirement_trackers=descriptors,failures=failures)


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\enrichment.py =====
"""Universal live item enrichment with independent optional evidence states."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from typing import Awaitable, Callable, TypeVar
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError
from .models import (
    AttachmentsResponse,
    EnrichmentSection,
    ItemEnrichmentV2,
    RelationsResponse,
    SourceFailure,
    TrackerItem,
)

T = TypeVar("T")

class CodebeamerEnrichmentService:
    def __init__(self, client):
        self.client = client

    async def enrich(self, item_id: int, *, include_relations: bool = True, include_attachments: bool = True) -> ItemEnrichmentV2:
        retrieved_at = _now()
        item = await self.client.get_item(item_id)
        item_section = EnrichmentSection(status="loaded", retrievedAt=retrieved_at, count=1, data=item)

        relations_task = self._optional("item-relations", self.client.get_relations(item_id)) if include_relations else None
        attachments_task = self._optional("item-attachments", self.client.get_attachments(item_id)) if include_attachments else None
        pending = [task for task in (relations_task, attachments_task) if task is not None]
        completed = await asyncio.gather(*pending) if pending else []
        cursor = iter(completed)

        relations = next(cursor) if include_relations else EnrichmentSection(status="not-requested")
        attachments = next(cursor) if include_attachments else EnrichmentSection(status="not-requested")
        failures = [failure for section in (relations, attachments) for failure in section.failures]
        overall = "complete" if not failures else "partial-success"
        return ItemEnrichmentV2(status=overall, item=item_section, relations=relations, attachments=attachments, failures=failures, retrievedAt=retrieved_at)

    async def _optional(self, stage: str, operation: Awaitable[T]) -> EnrichmentSection:
        try:
            data = await operation
            count = _count(data)
            return EnrichmentSection(status="loaded-empty" if count == 0 else "loaded", retrievedAt=_now(), count=count, data=data)
        except CodebeamerError as exc:
            failure = exc.failure(stage)
            return EnrichmentSection(status="failed", retrievedAt=_now(), failures=[failure])
        except Exception as exc:
            failure = SourceFailure(stage=stage, classification="unexpected", message=str(exc), retryable=False)
            return EnrichmentSection(status="failed", retrievedAt=_now(), failures=[failure])

def _count(value: object) -> int:
    if isinstance(value, RelationsResponse): return value.itemCount
    if isinstance(value, AttachmentsResponse): return value.total
    return 1

def _now() -> str:
    return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\extractor.py =====
"""Complete paginated requirement extraction."""
from __future__ import annotations
import asyncio
from .client import CodebeamerClient
from .config import CodebeamerConfig
from .diagnostics import CodebeamerError, CodebeamerPaginationError
from .discovery import CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer
from .models import ExtractionResult, RequirementTrackerDescriptor, TrackerExtraction

class CodebeamerRequirementExtractor:
    def __init__(self,client:CodebeamerClient,config:CodebeamerConfig): self.client=client; self.config=config
    async def extract_tracker(self,tracker:RequirementTrackerDescriptor)->TrackerExtraction:
        items={}; pages=duplicates=expected=0; previous_signature=None
        try:
            for page_number in range(1,self.config.max_pages+1):
                page=await self.client.query_tracker_items(tracker.tracker_id,page_number,self.config.page_size); pages+=1; expected=max(expected,page.total)
                signature=tuple(item.id for item in page.items)
                if not page.items: return TrackerExtraction(tracker=tracker,items=list(items.values()),pages_requested=pages,duplicate_items=duplicates,expected_total=expected,complete=len(items)>=expected)
                if signature==previous_signature: raise CodebeamerPaginationError(f"Repeated page detected for tracker {tracker.tracker_id} at page {page_number}.",operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker.tracker_id))
                before=len(items)
                for item in page.items:
                    if item.id in items: duplicates+=1
                    items[item.id]=item
                if len(items)>=page.total or page.isLastPage is True: return TrackerExtraction(tracker=tracker,items=sorted(items.values(),key=lambda x:((x.ordinal or 10**9),x.id)),pages_requested=pages,duplicate_items=duplicates,expected_total=expected,complete=True)
                if len(items)==before: raise CodebeamerPaginationError(f"Pagination made no progress for tracker {tracker.tracker_id} at page {page_number}.",operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker.tracker_id))
                previous_signature=signature
            raise CodebeamerPaginationError(f"Tracker {tracker.tracker_id} exceeded maximum page limit {self.config.max_pages}.",operation="query-tracker-items",source_id=str(tracker.tracker_id))
        except CodebeamerError as exc:
            return TrackerExtraction(tracker=tracker,items=sorted(items.values(),key=lambda x:x.id),pages_requested=pages,duplicate_items=duplicates,expected_total=expected,complete=False,failure=exc.failure("tracker"))
    async def extract_all(self,discoverer:CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer|None=None)->ExtractionResult:
        discovery=await (discoverer or CodebeamerCatalogDiscoverer(self.client,self.config)).discover()
        semaphore=asyncio.Semaphore(self.config.max_concurrency)
        async def run(t):
            async with semaphore: return await self.extract_tracker(t)
        trackers=await asyncio.gather(*(run(t) for t in discovery.requirement_trackers))
        return ExtractionResult(instance_key=self.config.instance_key,trackers=list(trackers),discovery_failures=discovery.failures)

"""Deterministic requirement hierarchy construction."""
from .mapper import canonical_item_id
from .models import HierarchyEdge,NormalizedRequirement
def hierarchy_edge_id(instance_key:str,parent_id:int,child_id:int)->str:return f"codebeamer:{instance_key}:hierarchy:{parent_id}:{child_id}"
def build_hierarchy(requirements:list[NormalizedRequirement])->tuple[list[HierarchyEdge],int]:
    pairs=[]; by_id={r.item_id:r for r in requirements}; instance=requirements[0].source_instance if requirements else "unknown"
    for item in requirements:
        if item.parent_id is not None:pairs.append((item.parent_id,item.item_id))
        pairs.extend((item.item_id,child) for child in item.child_ids)
    unique=sorted(set(pairs)); duplicates=len(pairs)-len(unique)
    return [HierarchyEdge(id=hierarchy_edge_id(instance,p,c),source=canonical_item_id(instance,p),target=canonical_item_id(instance,c),parent_id=p,child_id=c,unresolved_parent=p not in by_id,unresolved_child=c not in by_id) for p,c in unique if p!=c],duplicates

"""Map Codebeamer items into stable normalized requirement documents."""
from __future__ import annotations
import html,re
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from typing import Any
from .models import NormalizedRequirement,RequirementTrackerDescriptor,TrackerItem
_TAG_RE=re.compile(r"<[^>]+>"); _WIKI_RE=re.compile(r"(?:\[\[|\]\]|\{\{|\}\}|''+)"); _WS_RE=re.compile(r"\s+")
def clean_text(value:str|None)->str:
    if not value:return ""
    return _WS_RE.sub(" ",_WIKI_RE.sub(" ",_TAG_RE.sub(" ",html.unescape(value)))).strip()
def canonical_item_id(instance_key:str,item_id:int)->str:return f"codebeamer:{instance_key}:item:{item_id}"
def _names(values:list[Any])->list[str]:return [clean_text(getattr(v,"name",None)) for v in values if clean_text(getattr(v,"name",None))]
def _custom(values:list[Any])->dict[str,str|int|float|bool]:
    out={}
    for value in values[:50]:
        if hasattr(value,"model_dump"):value=value.model_dump()
        if not isinstance(value,dict):continue
        key=str(value.get("name") or value.get("fieldName") or value.get("id") or "").strip(); raw=value.get("value")
        if key and isinstance(raw,(str,int,float,bool)):out[key]=clean_text(raw) if isinstance(raw,str) else raw
    return out
def map_requirement(item:TrackerItem,tracker:RequirementTrackerDescriptor,instance_key:str,synchronized_at:str|None=None)->NormalizedRequirement:
    synchronized_at=synchronized_at or datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    return NormalizedRequirement(source_instance=instance_key,canonical_id=canonical_item_id(instance_key,item.id),project_id=tracker.project_id,project_name=clean_text(tracker.project_name),tracker_id=tracker.tracker_id,tracker_name=clean_text(tracker.tracker_name),tracker_type=tracker.tracker_type,item_id=item.id,external_key=f"{tracker.tracker_key}-{item.id}" if tracker.tracker_key else str(item.id),type_name=item.typeName or "Requirement",name=clean_text(item.name),description=clean_text(item.description),status=clean_text(item.status.name) if item.status else None,priority=clean_text(item.priority.name) if item.priority else None,categories=_names(item.categories),severities=_names(item.severities),parent_id=item.parent.id if item.parent else None,parent_name=clean_text(item.parent.name) if item.parent else None,child_ids=[c.id for c in item.children],child_names=_names(item.children),version=item.version,ordinal=item.ordinal,created_at=item.createdAt,modified_at=item.modifiedAt,synchronized_at=synchronized_at,custom_fields=_custom(item.customFields))

===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\ranking.py =====
"""Deterministic lexical ranking with term-coverage precision guards."""
from __future__ import annotations

import html
import re
import unicodedata
from dataclasses import dataclass

from .models import NormalizedRequirement

_DASHES = str.maketrans({"â€“": "-", "â€”": "-", "âˆ’": "-", "â€": "-"})
_WS = re.compile(r"\s+")
_PUNCT = re.compile(r"[^a-z0-9.\-]+")
_IDENTIFIER_TOKEN = re.compile(r"^[a-z]+[- ]?\d+(?:[-.]\d+)*$")


def normalize_text(value: str | None) -> str:
    text = unicodedata.normalize("NFKC", html.unescape(value or ""))
    text = text.translate(_DASHES).casefold()
    return _WS.sub(" ", _PUNCT.sub(" ", text)).strip()


def compact_identifier(value: str | None) -> str:
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "", normalize_text(value))


def query_terms(query: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(part for part in normalize_text(query).split() if part)


def _matched_terms(terms: tuple[str, ...], field: str) -> tuple[str, ...]:
    return tuple(term for term in terms if term in field)


def _all_terms(terms: tuple[str, ...], field: str) -> bool:
    return bool(terms) and len(_matched_terms(terms, field)) == len(terms)


def _strong_partial_match(terms: tuple[str, ...], field: str) -> bool:
    """Allow partial matching only when enough query meaning is preserved.

    Single-term queries keep normal lexical behavior. Multi-term queries must
    match at least two terms and at least two thirds of the distinct terms.
    Two-term queries therefore require both terms and fall through to the
    stronger all-term rule instead of producing noisy one-token matches.
    """
    if not terms:
        return False
    unique_terms = tuple(dict.fromkeys(terms))
    matched = _matched_terms(unique_terms, field)
    if len(unique_terms) == 1:
        return len(matched) == 1
    coverage = len(matched) / len(unique_terms)
    return len(matched) >= 2 and coverage >= (2 / 3) and len(matched) < len(unique_terms)


def _identifier_in_name(query: str, name: str) -> bool:
    normalized_query = normalize_text(query)
    if not _IDENTIFIER_TOKEN.fullmatch(normalized_query):
        return False
    wanted = compact_identifier(normalized_query)
    return any(compact_identifier(token) == wanted for token in name.split())


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class RankingOutcome:
    score: int
    classification: str
    matched_fields: tuple[str, ...]
    explanation: str


def rank_requirement(
    requirement: NormalizedRequirement,
    query: str,
) -> RankingOutcome | None:
    phrase = normalize_text(query)
    terms = query_terms(query)
    if not phrase:
        return None

    direct = {
        "externalKey": normalize_text(requirement.external_key),
        "name": normalize_text(requirement.name),
        "description": normalize_text(requirement.description),
        **{
            f"customFields.{key}": normalize_text(str(value))
            for key, value in requirement.custom_fields.items()
        },
    }
    context = {
        "parentName": normalize_text(requirement.parent_name),
        "childNames": normalize_text(" ".join(requirement.child_names)),
        "projectName": normalize_text(requirement.project_name),
        "trackerName": normalize_text(requirement.tracker_name),
        "categories": normalize_text(" ".join(requirement.categories)),
        "severities": normalize_text(" ".join(requirement.severities)),
        "priority": normalize_text(requirement.priority),
        "status": normalize_text(requirement.status),
    }

    scores: dict[str, int] = {}
    reasons: dict[str, str] = {}
    compact_query = compact_identifier(query)

    if phrase == direct["externalKey"] or (
        compact_query
        and compact_query == compact_identifier(requirement.external_key)
    ):
        scores["externalKey"] = 100
        reasons["externalKey"] = "Exact external identifier matched."

    name = direct["name"]
    if phrase == name:
        scores["name"] = 95
        reasons["name"] = "Exact requirement name matched."
    elif _identifier_in_name(query, name):
        scores["name"] = 90
        reasons["name"] = "Exact requirement identifier matched in the name."
    elif name.startswith(phrase):
        scores["name"] = 85
        reasons["name"] = "Requirement name begins with the query."
    elif phrase in name:
        scores["name"] = 75
        reasons["name"] = "Exact phrase matched the requirement name."
    elif _all_terms(terms, name):
        scores["name"] = 70
        reasons["name"] = "All query terms matched the requirement name."
    elif _strong_partial_match(terms, name):
        scores["name"] = 55
        reasons["name"] = "Most query terms matched the requirement name."

    description = direct["description"]
    if phrase in description:
        scores["description"] = 60
        reasons["description"] = "Exact phrase matched the requirement description."
    elif _all_terms(terms, description):
        scores["description"] = 50
        reasons["description"] = "All query terms matched the requirement description."
    elif _strong_partial_match(terms, description):
        scores["description"] = 35
        reasons["description"] = "Most query terms matched the requirement description."

    for field, value in direct.items():
        if not field.startswith("customFields."):
            continue
        if phrase in value:
            scores[field] = 45
            reasons[field] = "Exact phrase matched a custom field."
        elif _all_terms(terms, value):
            scores[field] = 40
            reasons[field] = "All query terms matched a custom field."

    for field in ("parentName", "childNames"):
        value = context[field]
        if phrase in value:
            scores[field] = 40
            reasons[field] = "Exact phrase matched requirement hierarchy context."
        elif _all_terms(terms, value):
            scores[field] = 35
            reasons[field] = "All query terms matched requirement hierarchy context."

    if phrase in context["projectName"]:
        scores["projectName"] = 30
        reasons["projectName"] = "Query matched the Codebeamer project context."
    elif _all_terms(terms, context["projectName"]):
        scores["projectName"] = 25
        reasons["projectName"] = "All query terms matched the Codebeamer project context."

    if phrase in context["trackerName"]:
        scores["trackerName"] = 20
        reasons["trackerName"] = "Query matched the Codebeamer tracker context."
    elif _all_terms(terms, context["trackerName"]):
        scores["trackerName"] = 18
        reasons["trackerName"] = "All query terms matched the Codebeamer tracker context."

    for field in ("categories", "severities"):
        if phrase in context[field]:
            scores[field] = 15
            reasons[field] = "Query matched requirement classification metadata."

    for field in ("priority", "status"):
        if phrase in context[field]:
            scores[field] = 10
            reasons[field] = "Query matched requirement workflow metadata."

    if not scores:
        return None

    matched = tuple(sorted(scores, key=lambda field: (-scores[field], field)))
    classification = (
        "direct"
        if any(
            field in {"externalKey", "name", "description"}
            or field.startswith("customFields.")
            for field in matched
        )
        else "contextual"
    )
    strongest = matched[0]
    return RankingOutcome(
        score=max(scores.values()),
        classification=classification,
        matched_fields=matched,
        explanation=reasons[strongest],
    )


def result_sort_key(result):
    return (
        -result.score,
        0 if result.classification == "direct" else 1,
        result.name.casefold(),
        result.project_name.casefold(),
        result.tracker_name.casefold(),
        result.item_id,
    )


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\search.py =====
"""Search the verified local Codebeamer catalog without source API calls."""
from __future__ import annotations
from .models import RequirementSearchRequest,RequirementSearchResponse,RequirementSearchResult
from .ranking import normalize_text,rank_requirement,result_sort_key
from .storage import FileCatalogRepository
class EmptySearchQueryError(ValueError):pass
class CatalogUnavailableError(RuntimeError):pass
class CodebeamerSearchService:
    def __init__(self,repository:FileCatalogRepository):self.repository=repository
    def search(self,request:RequirementSearchRequest)->RequirementSearchResponse:
        if not normalize_text(request.query):raise EmptySearchQueryError("Search query cannot be empty.")
        if not 1<=request.limit<=500:raise ValueError("Search limit must be between 1 and 500.")
        catalog=self.repository.load_catalog()
        if catalog is None:raise CatalogUnavailableError("Codebeamer catalog is unavailable. Run synchronization first.")
        matches=[]
        for requirement in catalog.requirements:
            if not request.include_stale and requirement.stale:continue
            if request.project_id is not None and requirement.project_id!=request.project_id:continue
            if request.tracker_id is not None and requirement.tracker_id!=request.tracker_id:continue
            outcome=rank_requirement(requirement,request.query)
            if outcome is None or outcome.score<request.minimum_score:continue
            if not request.include_contextual and outcome.classification=="contextual":continue
            matches.append(RequirementSearchResult(canonical_id=requirement.canonical_id,item_id=requirement.item_id,external_key=requirement.external_key,name=requirement.name,description=requirement.description,project_id=requirement.project_id,project_name=requirement.project_name,tracker_id=requirement.tracker_id,tracker_name=requirement.tracker_name,status=requirement.status,priority=requirement.priority,categories=requirement.categories,severities=requirement.severities,parent_name=requirement.parent_name,child_names=requirement.child_names,version=requirement.version,stale=requirement.stale,score=outcome.score,classification=outcome.classification,matched_fields=list(outcome.matched_fields),explanation=outcome.explanation))
        matches.sort(key=result_sort_key)
        return RequirementSearchResponse(query=request.query,normalized_query=normalize_text(request.query),catalog_revision=catalog.revision,catalog_status=catalog.status,catalog_synchronized_at=catalog.synchronized_at,catalog_requirement_count=len(catalog.requirements),matches=matches[:request.limit])


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\src\codebeamer_extractor\storage.py =====
"""Atomic file-backed catalog persistence with integrity verification."""
import hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from .models import CatalogSnapshot,SyncState
class CatalogIntegrityError(RuntimeError):pass
def _canonical(value:Any)->str:return json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"))
def _hash(payload:dict[str,Any])->str:
    value=dict(payload);value.pop("integrity_hash",None);return "sha256:"+hashlib.sha256(_canonical(value).encode()).hexdigest()
class FileCatalogRepository:
    def __init__(self,data_dir:str|Path):self.data_dir=Path(data_dir);self.catalog_file=self.data_dir/"catalog.json";self.sync_file=self.data_dir/"sync-state.json"
    def _write(self,path:Path,payload:dict[str,Any])->None:
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);tmp=path.with_name(f"{path.name}.{os.getpid()}.tmp");tmp.write_text(json.dumps(payload,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding="utf-8");os.replace(tmp,path)
    def save_catalog(self,snapshot:CatalogSnapshot)->None:
        payload=snapshot.model_dump(mode="json");payload["integrity_hash"]=_hash(payload);self._write(self.catalog_file,payload)
    def load_catalog(self)->CatalogSnapshot|None:
        if not self.catalog_file.exists():return None
        payload=json.loads(self.catalog_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig"));expected=payload.get("integrity_hash")
        if not expected or expected!=_hash(payload):raise CatalogIntegrityError("Codebeamer catalog integrity verification failed.")
        return CatalogSnapshot.model_validate(payload)
    def save_sync_state(self,state:SyncState)->None:self._write(self.sync_file,state.model_dump(mode="json"))
    def load_sync_state(self)->SyncState|None:return SyncState.model_validate_json(self.sync_file.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")) if self.sync_file.exists() else None

import hashlib

from .models import CatalogSnapshot,SyncState,TrackerSyncState
from .storage import FileCatalogRepository
def _now()->str:return datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
def _revision(instance:str,at:str,count:int)->str:return hashlib.sha256(f"{instance}|{at}|{count}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16]
class CodebeamerSyncCoordinator:
    def __init__(self,extractor,repository:FileCatalogRepository):self.extractor=extractor;self.repository=repository
    async def synchronize(self,discoverer=None)->CatalogSnapshot:
        previous=self.repository.load_catalog();result=await self.extractor.extract_all(discoverer);at=_now();failures=list(result.discovery_failures);previous_by_tracker={}
        if previous:
            for item in previous.requirements:previous_by_tracker.setdefault(item.tracker_id,[]).append(item)
        requirements=[];states=[]
        for extracted in result.trackers:
            tid=extracted.tracker.tracker_id
            if extracted.failure:
                failures.append(extracted.failure);preserved=[item.model_copy(update={"stale":True}) for item in previous_by_tracker.get(tid,[])];requirements.extend(preserved);states.append(TrackerSyncState(tracker_id=tid,project_id=extracted.tracker.project_id,status="stale" if preserved else "failed",requirement_count=len(preserved),synchronized_at=at,failure=extracted.failure));continue
            mapped=[map_requirement(item,extracted.tracker,result.instance_key,at) for item in extracted.items];requirements.extend(mapped);states.append(TrackerSyncState(tracker_id=tid,project_id=extracted.tracker.project_id,status="complete",requirement_count=len(mapped),synchronized_at=at))
        requirements.sort(key=lambda x:(x.project_name.casefold(),x.tracker_name.casefold(),x.ordinal or 10**9,x.item_id));hierarchy,duplicates=build_hierarchy(requirements);status="partial" if failures else "complete";revision=_revision(result.instance_key,at,len(requirements))
        snapshot=CatalogSnapshot(instance_key=result.instance_key,revision=revision,synchronized_at=at,status=status,requirements=requirements,hierarchy=hierarchy,tracker_states=states,failures=failures,duplicate_hierarchy_edges_removed=duplicates)
        old_state=self.repository.load_sync_state();state=SyncState(instance_key=result.instance_key,last_attempt_at=at,last_successful_sync_at=at if status=="complete" else (old_state.last_successful_sync_at if old_state else None),catalog_revision=revision,status=status,requirement_count=len(requirements),hierarchy_edge_count=len(hierarchy),tracker_count=len(states),stale_tracker_count=sum(s.status=="stale" for s in states),failed_tracker_count=sum(s.status=="failed" for s in states));self.repository.save_catalog(snapshot);self.repository.save_sync_state(state);return snapshot

    async def query_tracker_items(self,tracker_id,page,page_size):

===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\tests\test_ranking.py =====
from codebeamer_extractor.models import NormalizedRequirement
from codebeamer_extractor.ranking import normalize_text, rank_requirement


def requirement(**overrides):
    values = dict(
        source_instance="primary",
        canonical_id="codebeamer:primary:item:1",
        project_id=9,
        project_name="Steering Requirements",
        tracker_id=9734,
        tracker_name="Customer Requirement Specifications",
        tracker_type="Requirement",
        item_id=1,
        external_key="CRS-1190",
        name="SR-001 Steering Material",
        description="The component shall use Mild Steel and weigh 2.5 kg.",
        parent_name="Steering System Requirements",
        synchronized_at="now",
    )
    values.update(overrides)
    return NormalizedRequirement(**values)


def test_exact_external_identifier_receives_highest_score():
    item = requirement(external_key="SR-001")
    assert rank_requirement(item, "SR 001").score == 100


def test_identifier_in_requirement_name_receives_strong_score():
    result = rank_requirement(requirement(), "SR-001")
    assert result.score == 90
    assert result.explanation == "Exact requirement identifier matched in the name."


def test_description_phrase_is_direct():
    result = rank_requirement(requirement(), "mild steel")
    assert result.score == 60
    assert result.classification == "direct"
    assert "description" in result.matched_fields


def test_context_only_match_is_contextual():
    result = rank_requirement(
        requirement(name="Material", description="Steel"),
        "steering requirements",
    )
    assert result.classification == "contextual"


def test_numeric_units_and_hyphens_are_preserved():
    assert normalize_text("2.5 kg") == "2.5 kg"
    assert rank_requirement(requirement(), "2.5 kg") is not None
    assert normalize_text("SRâ€“001") == "sr-001"


def test_two_term_query_does_not_match_one_weak_term():
    item = requirement(
        name="Revision History",
        description="Version 2.5 introduced a new record.",
        project_name="Generic",
        parent_name=None,
    )
    assert rank_requirement(item, "2.5 kg") is None


def test_three_term_query_does_not_match_one_weak_term():
    item = requirement(
        name="BSD right warning requirements",
        description="Warning appears on the right side.",
        project_name="Generic",
        parent_name=None,
    )
    assert rank_requirement(item, "right hand drive") is None


def test_three_term_query_allows_meaningful_two_term_coverage():
    item = requirement(
        name="Right hand orientation",
        description="Orientation rule.",
        project_name="Generic",
        parent_name=None,
    )
    result = rank_requirement(item, "right hand drive")
    assert result is not None
    assert result.score == 55


===== FILE: .\codebeamer_extractor\tests\test_search.py =====
import pytest

from codebeamer_extractor.models import (
    CatalogSnapshot,
    NormalizedRequirement,
    RequirementSearchRequest,
)
from codebeamer_extractor.search import CodebeamerSearchService, EmptySearchQueryError
from codebeamer_extractor.storage import FileCatalogRepository


def item(item_id, name, description="", **overrides):
    values = dict(
        source_instance="primary",
        canonical_id=f"codebeamer:primary:item:{item_id}",
        project_id=9,
        project_name="Steering Requirements",
        tracker_id=9734,
        tracker_name="CRS",
        tracker_type="Requirement",
        item_id=item_id,
        external_key=f"CRS-{item_id}",
        name=name,
        description=description,
        synchronized_at="now",
    )
    values.update(overrides)
    return NormalizedRequirement(**values)


def service(tmp_path):
    repository = FileCatalogRepository(tmp_path)
    repository.save_catalog(
        CatalogSnapshot(
            instance_key="primary",
            revision="r1",
            synchronized_at="now",
            status="complete",
            requirements=[
                item(1, "SR-001 Steering Material", "Manufactured using Mild Steel"),
                item(2, "SR-006 Orientation Logic", "India uses Right Hand Drive"),
                item(3, "SR-003 Steering Weight", "Maximum weight is 2.5 kg"),
                item(4, "Revision History", "Version 2.5 introduced a record"),
                item(5, "BSD right warning", "Warning appears on the right side"),
                item(6, "Generic", project_name="Bike Platform", stale=True),
            ],
        )
    )
    return CodebeamerSearchService(repository)


def test_searches_description_and_returns_catalog_metadata(tmp_path):
    result = service(tmp_path).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query="mild steel"))
    assert result.catalog_revision == "r1"
    assert [match.item_id for match in result.matches] == [1]


def test_numeric_query_rejects_single_token_noise(tmp_path):
    result = service(tmp_path).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query="2.5 kg"))
    assert [match.item_id for match in result.matches] == [3]


def test_three_term_query_rejects_single_token_noise(tmp_path):
    result = service(tmp_path).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query="right hand drive"))
    assert result.matches[0].item_id == 2
    assert 5 not in [match.item_id for match in result.matches]


def test_identifier_in_name_is_ranked_strongly(tmp_path):
    result = service(tmp_path).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query="SR-001"))
    assert result.matches[0].item_id == 1
    assert result.matches[0].score == 90


def test_filters_stale_and_contextual_results(tmp_path):
    search = service(tmp_path)
    assert search.search(RequirementSearchRequest(query="bike")).matches
    assert not search.search(
        RequirementSearchRequest(query="bike", include_stale=False)
    ).matches
    assert not search.search(
        RequirementSearchRequest(query="bike", include_contextual=False)
    ).matches


def test_filters_project_and_tracker_and_limits_results(tmp_path):
    result = service(tmp_path).search(
        RequirementSearchRequest(
            query="steering",
            project_id=9,
            tracker_id=9734,
            limit=1,
        )
    )
    assert len(result.matches) == 1


def test_rejects_empty_query(tmp_path):
    with pytest.raises(EmptySearchQueryError):
        service(tmp_path).search(RequirementSearchRequest(query="   "))

import type { TreeNodeData } from "@/types/bom-comparison";
import type { NormalizedSearchResult } from "./contracts";
import type { ResolutionUpdate } from "./structure-resolver";

const API_BASE = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL || "http://localhost:5212/api";
const POLL_INTERVAL_MS = 500;
const TIMEOUT_MS = 120_000;

type JobState = "accepted" | "queued" | "checking-readiness" | "discovering" | "awaiting-selection" | "resolving" | "extracting" | "enriching" | "success" | "partial-success" | "empty" | "failed" | "unavailable" | "cancellation-requested" | "cancelled" | "timed-out";
type JobRecord = { jobId: string; state: JobState; currentStage?: string; progressPercent?: number; resultAvailable?: boolean; errors?: Array<{ userMessage?: string; message?: string }>; diagnostic?: { lastEvent?: string } };
type ExtractionResult = {
  sourceExecutionId: string;
  status: string;
  evidence?: {
    requirement?: Record<string, unknown>;
    sourceContext?: Record<string, unknown>;
    hierarchy?: { parentName?: string | null; childNames?: string[] };
    catalog?: Record<string, unknown>;
    liveEnrichment?: Record<string, unknown>;
  };
  provenance?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const sleep = (ms: number, signal: AbortSignal) => new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
  const id = window.setTimeout(resolve, ms);
  signal.addEventListener("abort", () => { window.clearTimeout(id); reject(new DOMException("Cancelled", "AbortError")); }, { once: true });
});
const text = (value: unknown) => value === null || value === undefined ? undefined : String(value);
const attributes = (values: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, string | number | boolean> => Object.entries(values).reduce<Record<string, string | number | boolean>>((output, [key, value]) => { if (typeof value === "string" || typeof value === "number" || typeof value === "boolean") output[key] = value; return output; }, {});
const notify = (result: NormalizedSearchResult, state: ResolutionUpdate["state"], message: string, extra: Partial<ResolutionUpdate>, onUpdate?: (value: ResolutionUpdate) => void) => onUpdate?.({ resultId: result.resultId, source: result.source, nativeId: result.nativeId, state, message, updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(), ...extra });

function candidate(result: NormalizedSearchResult) {
  return {
    candidateId: result.resultId,
    source: "Codebeamer",
    nativeId: result.nativeId,
    displayName: result.displayName,
    entityType: result.entityType,
    revision: result.revision ?? null,
    version: result.version ?? null,
    description: result.description ?? null,
    lifecycleState: result.lifecycleState ?? null,
    matchCategory: result.matchCategory,
    matchReason: result.matchReason,
    confidenceClass: result.matchCategory === "verified-identifier-match" ? "Verified" : "Probable",
    availableCapabilities: result.capabilityHints,
    sourceMetadata: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(result.sourceMetadata).map(([key, value]) => [key, value === null ? null : String(value)])),
    provenance: {
      kind: "CachedSourceResult",
      provider: "codebeamer_extractor",
      observedAt: result.provenance.retrievedAt,
      reference: result.resultId,
    },
    canExtract: result.canStartInvestigation,
  };
}

function requirementTree(result: NormalizedSearchResult, extraction: ExtractionResult): TreeNodeData {
  const evidence = extraction.evidence ?? {};
  const requirement = evidence.requirement ?? {};
  const source = evidence.sourceContext ?? {};
  const hierarchy = evidence.hierarchy ?? {};
  const catalog = evidence.catalog ?? {};
  const parent = hierarchy.parentName ? [{ id: `${result.resultId}:parent`, name: hierarchy.parentName, attributes: { "Entity Type": "Parent Requirement", "Relationship": "parent" }, children: [] }] : [];
  const children = (hierarchy.childNames ?? []).map((name, index) => ({ id: `${result.resultId}:child:${index}`, name, attributes: { "Entity Type": "Child Requirement", "Relationship": "child" }, children: [] }));
  return {
    id: result.resultId,
    name: text(requirement.name) ?? result.displayName,
    attributes: attributes({
      "Entity Type": "Requirement",
      "Item ID": text(requirement.itemId) ?? result.nativeId,
      "External Key": text(requirement.externalKey) ?? text(result.sourceMetadata.externalKey),
      "Description": text(requirement.description) ?? result.description,
      "Status": text(requirement.status),
      "Priority": text(requirement.priority),
      "Version": text(requirement.version) ?? result.version,
      "Categories": Array.isArray(requirement.categories) ? requirement.categories.join(", ") : undefined,
      "Severities": Array.isArray(requirement.severities) ? requirement.severities.join(", ") : undefined,
      "Project": text(source.projectName),
      "Tracker": text(source.trackerName),
      "Catalog Revision": text(catalog.revision),
      "Catalog Status": text(catalog.status),
      "Catalog Synchronized At": text(catalog.synchronizedAt),
      "Source Execution ID": extraction.sourceExecutionId,
    }),
    children: [...parent, ...children],
  };
}

export async function extractCodebeamerRequirement(result: NormalizedSearchResult, signal: AbortSignal, onUpdate?: (value: ResolutionUpdate) => void) {
  notify(result, "starting", "Starting Codebeamer requirement extraction.", {}, onUpdate);
  const requestId = `lcb2-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/engineering/extractions`, {
    method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
    body: JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: "1.0", requestId, correlationId: requestId, source: "Codebeamer", candidate: candidate(result), requestedEvidence: ["requirement", "sourceContext", "hierarchy", "catalog", "liveEnrichment"], organizationContext: null, timeoutPolicy: { timeoutMs: TIMEOUT_MS }, initiatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }),
    signal,
  });
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Codebeamer extraction could not start (${response.status}).`);
  const accepted = await response.json() as { jobId?: string };
  if (!accepted.jobId) throw new Error("Codebeamer extraction did not return a job ID.");
  const jobId = accepted.jobId;
  const started = Date.now();
  while (Date.now() - started < TIMEOUT_MS) {
    if (signal.aborted) throw new DOMException("Cancelled", "AbortError");
    const statusResponse = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/engineering/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`, { cache: "no-store", signal });
    if (!statusResponse.ok) throw new Error(`Codebeamer extraction status failed (${statusResponse.status}).`);
    const job = await statusResponse.json() as JobRecord;
    notify(result, "extracting", job.diagnostic?.lastEvent ?? "Extracting Codebeamer requirement evidence.", { jobId, progressPercent: job.progressPercent ?? 0 }, onUpdate);
    if (job.state === "success" || job.state === "partial-success") {
      if (!job.resultAvailable) { await sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MS, signal); continue; }
      const resultResponse = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/engineering/jobs/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}/result`, { cache: "no-store", signal });
      if (!resultResponse.ok) throw new Error(`Codebeamer extraction result failed (${resultResponse.status}).`);
      const extraction = await resultResponse.json() as ExtractionResult;
      const state = job.state === "partial-success" ? "partial" as const : "ready" as const;
      notify(result, state, "Codebeamer requirement evidence is ready.", { jobId, progressPercent: 100 }, onUpdate);
      return { root: requirementTree(result, extraction), intelligencePayload: extraction as unknown as Record<string, unknown>, jobId, state };
    }
    if (["failed", "unavailable", "empty", "cancelled", "timed-out"].includes(job.state)) throw new Error(job.errors?.[0]?.userMessage ?? job.errors?.[0]?.message ?? `Codebeamer extraction ended with ${job.state}.`);
    await sleep(POLL_INTERVAL_MS, signal);
  }
  throw new DOMException("Codebeamer extraction exceeded 120 seconds.", "TimeoutError");
}

import type { LatticeSource, MatchCategory, SourceSearchOutcome } from "./contracts";
import { SOURCE_LABELS } from "./capability-matrix";

export type DiscoveryPresentation = {
  label: "Not included" | "Ready" | "Searching" | "Results found" | "No results" | "Needs attention";
  title: string;
  message: string;
  technicalDetail?: string;
  actionLabel?: string;
  tone: "idle" | "active" | "success" | "muted" | "warning";
};

const sourceNoun: Record<LatticeSource,string> = { teamcenter:"Teamcenter record", windchill:"Windchill part", sap:"SAP material", configit:"Configit package", codebeamer:"Codebeamer requirement" };

export function presentOutcome(source:LatticeSource,outcome:SourceSearchOutcome|null,query:string):DiscoveryPresentation{
  if(outcome?.status==="not-requested") return {label:"Not included",title:SOURCE_LABELS[source],message:"This application was not included in the current search.",tone:"muted"};
  if(!outcome) return {label:"Ready",title:SOURCE_LABELS[source],message:`Search ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} with the same product query.`,tone:"idle"};
  if(["checking-readiness","searching"].includes(outcome.status)) return {label:"Searching",title:`Searching ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]}`,message:`Looking for matching ${sourceNoun[source].toLowerCase()}s.`,tone:"active"};
  if(outcome.status==="succeeded"||outcome.status==="partial") return {label:"Results found",title:`${outcome.results.length} match${outcome.results.length===1?"":"es"} in ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]}`,message:"Choose the record that belongs in this investigation.",technicalDetail:outcome.warning,tone:"success"};
  if(outcome.status==="empty"){
    const message=source==="sap"&&outcome.warning?"The latest available SAP catalogue did not contain this material. Catalogue data may be out of date.":source==="configit"?`No configurable package matched ${query}.`:`No ${sourceNoun[source].toLowerCase()} matched ${query}.`;
    return {label:"No results",title:source==="configit"?"Configit package not found":`No current ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} match`,message,technicalDetail:outcome.warning,actionLabel:outcome.retryable?`Search ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} again`:undefined,tone:"muted"};
  }
  if(outcome.status==="cancelled") return {label:"Needs attention",title:`${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} search stopped`,message:"The search was cancelled. Results from other sources are still available.",actionLabel:`Retry ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]}`,tone:"warning"};
  const unavailable=outcome.status==="unavailable";
  return {label:"Needs attention",title:unavailable?`${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} is temporarily unavailable`:`${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} needs attention`,message:`${SOURCE_LABELS[source]} could not be searched right now. Results from other sources are still available.`,technicalDetail:outcome.error?.safeDetail??outcome.error?.message??outcome.warning,actionLabel:`Retry ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]}`,tone:"warning"};
}

export function presentMatch(category:MatchCategory){
  if(category==="verified-identifier-match"||category==="deterministic-normalized-id-match") return "Verified match";
  if(category==="source-native-reference") return "Source record";
  if(category==="exact-normalized-name-match"||category==="structure-supported-probable-match"||category==="probable-match") return "Likely match";
  if(category==="ambiguous-candidate") return "Review match";
  return "Unresolved";
}

export function cleanInvestigationLabel(value:string){
  const parts=value.split(/\s*[+|Ãƒâ€šÃ‚Â·]\s*/).map(item=>item.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  const unique=[...new Set(parts)];
  if(unique.length) return unique[0];
  const half=value.slice(0,Math.floor(value.length/2));
  return half&&value===half+half?half:value||"Engineering investigation";
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\discovery\discovery-reducer.ts =====
import type {
  CorrespondenceCandidate,
  FederatedSearchSnapshot,
  NormalizedSearchResult,
} from "./contracts";

export interface DiscoveryState {
  query: string;
  snapshot: FederatedSearchSnapshot | null;
  selectedResultIds: Set<string>;
  correspondences: CorrespondenceCandidate[];
  announcement: string;
  selectedSources: Set<import("./contracts").LatticeSource>;
}

export type DiscoveryAction =
  | { type: "query"; value: string }
  | { type: "snapshot"; value: FederatedSearchSnapshot | null }
  | { type: "select"; result: NormalizedSearchResult }
  | { type: "select-many"; resultIds: string[]; mode: "replace" | "add" | "clear" }
  | { type: "toggle-source"; source: import("./contracts").LatticeSource }
  | { type: "correspondences"; value: CorrespondenceCandidate[] }
  | { type: "review"; id: string; state: "accepted" | "rejected" }
  | { type: "reset" };

export const initialDiscoveryState: DiscoveryState = {
  query: "",
  snapshot: null,
  selectedResultIds: new Set(),
  correspondences: [],
  announcement: "Discovery ready.",
  selectedSources: new Set(["windchill", "sap"]),
};

export function discoveryReducer(
  state: DiscoveryState,
  action: DiscoveryAction,
): DiscoveryState {
  switch (action.type) {
    case "query":
      return { ...state, query: action.value };

    case "snapshot": {
      const completed = action.value
        ? Object.values(action.value.outcomes).filter(
            (item) =>
              !["checking-readiness", "searching", "idle"].includes(
                item.status,
              ),
          ).length
        : 0;
      const requested = action.value?.request.requestedSources.length ?? state.selectedSources.size;

      return {
        ...state,
        snapshot: action.value,
        announcement: action.value?.active
          ? `${completed} of ${requested} selected sources returned.`
          : "Federated search complete.",
      };
    }

    case "toggle-source": {
      const selectedSources = new Set(state.selectedSources);
      if (selectedSources.has(action.source)) selectedSources.delete(action.source); else selectedSources.add(action.source);
      const selectedResultIds = new Set([...state.selectedResultIds].filter((id) => {
        const result = state.snapshot ? Object.values(state.snapshot.outcomes).flatMap((value) => value.results).find((item) => item.resultId === id) : undefined;
        return !result || selectedSources.has(result.source);
      }));
      return { ...state, selectedSources, selectedResultIds, snapshot: null, announcement: `${action.source} ${selectedSources.has(action.source) ? "included" : "excluded"}. Run a new search.` };
    }
    case "select": {
      const next = new Set(state.selectedResultIds);

      if (next.has(action.result.resultId)) {
        next.delete(action.result.resultId);
      } else {
        next.add(action.result.resultId);
      }

      return {
        ...state,
        selectedResultIds: next,
        announcement: `${action.result.displayName} ${
          next.has(action.result.resultId) ? "selected" : "removed"
        }.`,
      };
    }

    case "select-many": {
      if (action.mode === "clear") return { ...state, selectedResultIds: new Set(), announcement: "Selection cleared." };
      const selectedResultIds = action.mode === "replace" ? new Set<string>() : new Set(state.selectedResultIds);
      action.resultIds.forEach((id) => selectedResultIds.add(id));
      return { ...state, selectedResultIds, announcement: `${action.resultIds.length} requirement${action.resultIds.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} selected.` };
    }

    case "correspondences":
      return { ...state, correspondences: action.value };

    case "review":
      return {
        ...state,
        correspondences: state.correspondences.map((item) =>
          item.correspondenceId === action.id
            ? { ...item, reviewState: action.state }
            : item,
        ),
      };

    case "reset":
      return initialDiscoveryState;
  }
}

            <div><p className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-100">Codebeamer requirement set</p><p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-400">{codebeamerResults.length} candidates found for â€œ{state.query}â€ Â· {directCodebeamerResults.length} direct or verified</p></div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
              <button type="button" onClick={() => selectCodebeamerSet("direct")} disabled={!directCodebeamerResults.length} className="rounded-lg border border-cyan-500/40 bg-cyan-500/10 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-200 disabled:opacity-40">Select direct matches</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => selectCodebeamerSet("all")} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-700 bg-slate-900 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200">Select all Codebeamer</button>
              <button type="button" onClick={() => selectCodebeamerSet("clear")} disabled={!selected.length} className="rounded-lg border border-slate-800 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-medium text-slate-400 disabled:opacity-40">Clear</button>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : null}

        {state.snapshot && !state.snapshot.active ? (
          <section className="mt-5 rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/70 p-4">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
              <div>
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold">
                  {selected.length
                    ? `Building one investigation from ${selected.length} selected record${selected.length === 1 ? "" : "s"}`
                    : "Select a source record to continue"}
                </p>
                <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                  Likely and ambiguous records stay separate until identity
                  evidence supports unification.
                </p>
              </div>
              <button
                disabled={!selected.length || starting}
                onClick={async () => {
                  setStarting(true);
                  try {
                    await onInvestigate(
                      selected,
                      cleanInvestigationLabel(state.query),
                    );
                  } finally {
                    setStarting(false);
                  }
                }}
                className="inline-flex h-10 items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-cyan-600 px-4 text-sm font-semibold disabled:opacity-45"
              >
                <IconTopologyStar3 className="h-4 w-4" />
                {starting
                  ? "Resolving selected structures..."
                  : "Start investigation"}
              </button>
            </div>
            {selected.length ? (
              <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
                {selected.map((item) => (
                  <div
                    key={item.resultId}
                    className="rounded-xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/60 px-3 py-2"
                  >
                    <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-200">
                      {SOURCE_LABELS[item.source]}  {item.displayName}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1 truncate text-[11px] text-slate-500">
                      {item.nativeId}
                      {item.revision ? `  Revision ${item.revision}` : ""}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            ) : null}
          </section>
        ) : null}
        <p className="sr-only" aria-live="polite">
          {state.announcement}
        </p>
      </section>
    </main>
  );
}

function SourceCard({
  source,
  query,
  outcome,
  included,
  searchActive,
  selected,
  onSelect,
  onRetry,
  onToggleSource,
}: {
  source: LatticeSource;
  query: string;
  outcome: SourceSearchOutcome | null;
  included: boolean;
  searchActive: boolean;
  selected: Set<string>;
  onSelect: (result: NormalizedSearchResult) => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onToggleSource: () => void;
}) {
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = useState(false),
    [details, setDetails] = useState(false),
    state = presentOutcome(source, included ? outcome : ({ source, status: "not-requested" } as SourceSearchOutcome), query),
    items = outcome?.results ?? [],
    visible = expanded ? items : items.slice(0, 3);
  const tones = {
    teamcenter: "text-cyan-300",
    windchill: "text-green-300",
    sap: "text-sky-300",
    configit: "text-orange-400",
  };
  const sourceSelection = {
    teamcenter: "border-cyan-400 bg-cyan-500/10",
    windchill: "border-green-300 bg-green-400/10",
    sap: "border-sky-300 bg-sky-400/10",
    configit: "border-orange-500 bg-orange-500/10",
  };
  return (
    <section className={`rounded-2xl border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950/65 p-4 transition ${included ? "" : "opacity-60"}`}>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button type="button" disabled={searchActive} onClick={onToggleSource} aria-pressed={included} aria-label={`${included ? "Exclude" : "Include"} ${SOURCE_LABELS[source]}`} className="rounded text-slate-400 disabled:opacity-40">
              {included ? <IconSquareCheckFilled className="h-5 w-5 text-cyan-400" /> : <IconSquare className="h-5 w-5" />}
            </button>
            <p className={`text-sm font-semibold ${tones[source]}`}>
              {SOURCE_LABELS[source]}
            </p>
            <span
              className={`rounded-full border px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-semibold ${state.tone === "success" ? "border-emerald-500/30 bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-300" : state.tone === "warning" ? "border-amber-500/30 bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-300" : state.tone === "active" ? "border-cyan-500/30 bg-cyan-500/10 text-cyan-300" : "border-slate-700 text-slate-400"}`}
            >
              {state.label}
            </span>
          </div>
          <h3 className="mt-2 text-sm font-semibold text-slate-100">
            {state.title}
          </h3>
          <p className="mt-1 max-w-3xl text-xs leading-5 text-slate-400">
            {state.message}
          </p>
        </div>
        {state.actionLabel ? (
          <button
            onClick={onRetry}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-700 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-300"
          >
            <IconRefresh className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            {state.actionLabel}
          </button>
        ) : null}
      </div>
      {included && visible.length ? (
        <div className="mt-4 grid gap-2">
          {visible.map((result) => (
            <button
              key={result.resultId}
              onClick={() => onSelect(result)}
              className={`rounded-xl border p-3 text-left transition ${selected.has(result.resultId) ? sourceSelection[source] : "border-slate-800 bg-slate-900/55 hover:border-slate-700"}`}
            >
              <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <strong className="block truncate text-sm">
                    {result.displayName}
                  </strong>
                  <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500">
                    {friendlyReference(source, result)}
                  </p>
                </div>
                <span className="shrink-0 rounded-full border border-slate-700 px-2 py-1 text-[9px] font-semibold text-slate-400">
                  {presentMatch(result.matchCategory)}
                </span>
              </div>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : null}
      {included && items.length > 3 ? (
        <button
          onClick={() => setExpanded((value) => !value)}
          className="mt-3 inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-semibold text-cyan-300"
        >
          {expanded ? (
            <>
              <IconChevronUp className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Show fewer
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <IconChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              Show all {items.length} results
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      ) : null}
      {included && state.technicalDetail ? (
        <div className="mt-3">
          <button
            onClick={() => setDetails((value) => !value)}
            className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-300"
          >
            {details ? "Hide technical details" : "View technical details"}
          </button>
          {details ? (
            <p className="mt-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-800 bg-slate-950 p-3 font-mono text-[10px] leading-5 text-slate-500">
              {state.technicalDetail}
            </p>
          ) : null}
        </div>
      ) : null}
    </section>
  );
}
function friendlyReference(
  source: LatticeSource,
  result: NormalizedSearchResult,
) {
  const revision = result.revision ? `  Revision ${result.revision}` : "";
  if (source === "windchill")
    return `Part ${result.nativeId.replace(/^OR:wt\.part\.WTPart:/, "")}${revision}`;
  if (source === "sap") return `Material ${result.nativeId}${revision}`;
  if (source === "configit")
    return `Product ${result.nativeId}${result.version ? `  Package version ${result.version}` : ""}`;
  return `Item ${result.nativeId}${revision}`;
}
