import { LATTICE_SOURCES, SOURCE_CAPABILITIES } from "./capability-matrix";
import type { FederatedSearchRequest,FederatedSearchSnapshot,LatticeSource,SourceSearchOutcome } from "./contracts";
import { classifyQueryIntent,normalizeQuery } from "./query-intent";
import { rememberDiscoveryQuery } from "./search-query-store";
import type { SourceSearchAdapter } from "./source-adapters/base";
import { ApiSearchAdapter } from "./source-adapters/api-search-adapter";
type Listener=(snapshot:FederatedSearchSnapshot|null)=>void;
const adapters:SourceSearchAdapter[]=LATTICE_SOURCES.map(source=>new ApiSearchAdapter(source));
const now=()=>new Date().toISOString();
const pending=(source:LatticeSource,requestId:string):SourceSearchOutcome=>({source,requestId,status:"checking-readiness",results:[],startedAt:now(),durationMs:0,retryable:false,capabilitySnapshot:SOURCE_CAPABILITIES[source]});
const notRequested=(source:LatticeSource,requestId:string):SourceSearchOutcome=>({source,requestId,status:"not-requested",results:[],startedAt:now(),completedAt:now(),durationMs:0,retryable:false,capabilitySnapshot:SOURCE_CAPABILITIES[source]});
export class FederatedSearchOrchestrator{
 private activeRequestId:string|null=null;private controllers=new Map<LatticeSource,AbortController>();private snapshot:FederatedSearchSnapshot|null=null;private listeners=new Set<Listener>();
 subscribe(listener:Listener){this.listeners.add(listener);listener(this.snapshot);return()=>{this.listeners.delete(listener)}} getSnapshot(){return this.snapshot} private emit(){for(const listener of this.listeners)listener(this.snapshot)}
 private update(source:LatticeSource,outcome:SourceSearchOutcome){if(!this.snapshot||outcome.requestId!==this.activeRequestId)return;this.snapshot={...this.snapshot,outcomes:{...this.snapshot.outcomes,[source]:outcome}};const done=this.snapshot.request.requestedSources.every(item=>!["checking-readiness","searching"].includes(this.snapshot!.outcomes[item].status));if(done)this.snapshot={...this.snapshot,active:false,completedAt:now()};this.emit()}
 async search(query:string,requestedSources:LatticeSource[]){const sources=[...new Set(requestedSources)].filter(source=>LATTICE_SOURCES.includes(source));if(!sources.length)throw new Error("Select at least one source.");rememberDiscoveryQuery(query);this.cancel("superseded");const normalizedQuery=normalizeQuery(query);const request:FederatedSearchRequest={requestId:crypto.randomUUID(),query:normalizedQuery,normalizedQuery:normalizedQuery.toLowerCase(),queryIntent:classifyQueryIntent(normalizedQuery),requestedSources:sources,resultLimitPerSource:10,startedAt:now(),timeoutMs:30000};this.activeRequestId=request.requestId;this.snapshot={request,outcomes:Object.fromEntries(LATTICE_SOURCES.map(source=>[source,sources.includes(source)?pending(source,request.requestId):notRequested(source,request.requestId)])) as FederatedSearchSnapshot["outcomes"],active:true};this.emit();await Promise.all(sources.map(source=>this.execute(source,request)));return this.snapshot}
 async retry(source:LatticeSource){if(!this.snapshot||!this.snapshot.request.requestedSources.includes(source))return;const request=this.snapshot.request;this.update(source,{...pending(source,request.requestId),status:"searching"});await this.execute(source,request)}
 private async execute(source:LatticeSource,request:FederatedSearchRequest){const adapter=adapters.find(item=>item.source===source);if(!adapter)return;const controller=new AbortController();this.controllers.set(source,controller);this.update(source,{...pending(source,request.requestId),status:"searching"});const timeout=window.setTimeout(()=>controller.abort("timeout"),Math.min(request.timeoutMs,SOURCE_CAPABILITIES[source].timeoutPolicy.maximumMs));try{this.update(source,await adapter.search(request,controller.signal))}catch(cause){if(request.requestId!==this.activeRequestId)return;const timedOut=controller.signal.aborted&&controller.signal.reason==="timeout",cancelled=controller.signal.aborted&&!timedOut;this.update(source,{source,requestId:request.requestId,status:timedOut?"timed-out":cancelled?"cancelled":"failed",results:[],startedAt:request.startedAt,completedAt:now(),durationMs:Date.now()-Date.parse(request.startedAt),error:{code:timedOut?"timeout":cancelled?"cancelled":"connector-error",message:timedOut?"Source search timed out.":cancelled?"Source search cancelled.":cause instanceof Error?cause.message:"Source search failed."},retryable:timedOut||!cancelled,capabilitySnapshot:SOURCE_CAPABILITIES[source]})}finally{window.clearTimeout(timeout);this.controllers.delete(source)}}
 cancel(reason:"user"|"superseded"="user"){for(const controller of this.controllers.values())controller.abort(reason);this.controllers.clear();if(this.snapshot?.active){const outcomes={...this.snapshot.outcomes};for(const source of this.snapshot.request.requestedSources)if(["checking-readiness","searching"].includes(outcomes[source].status))outcomes[source]={...outcomes[source],status:"cancelled",completedAt:now(),error:{code:"cancelled",message:reason==="superseded"?"Superseded by a newer search.":"Search cancelled."}};this.snapshot={...this.snapshot,outcomes,active:false,completedAt:now()};this.emit()}if(reason==="superseded")this.activeRequestId=null}
 dispose(){this.cancel("user");this.listeners.clear()}
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\discovery\identity-resolution.ts =====
import type { CorrespondenceCandidate, NormalizedSearchResult } from "./contracts";
const normalized=(value:string)=>value.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,"");
export function buildCorrespondenceCandidates(results:NormalizedSearchResult[]):CorrespondenceCandidate[]{
  const output:CorrespondenceCandidate[]=[];
  for(let left=0;left<results.length;left+=1)for(let right=left+1;right<results.length;right+=1){const a=results[left],b=results[right];if(a.source===b.source)continue;const sameId=Boolean(a.nativeId&&b.nativeId&&normalized(a.nativeId)===normalized(b.nativeId));const sameName=normalized(a.displayName)===normalized(b.displayName);if(!sameId&&!sameName)continue;const category=sameId?"deterministic-normalized-id-match":"exact-normalized-name-match";output.push({correspondenceId:crypto.randomUUID(),sourceResultIds:[a.resultId,b.resultId],category,reason:sameId?"Normalized source identifiers are equal; source-native records remain distinct.":"Normalized labels are equal. This is not authoritative identity and requires review.",evidence:[{type:sameId?"normalized-id":"normalized-name",value:sameId?normalized(a.nativeId):normalized(a.displayName)}],confidenceClass:sameId?"deterministic":"ambiguous",reviewState:sameId?"unreviewed":"ambiguous",conflicts:[],createdBy:"system",createdAt:new Date().toISOString()});}
  return output;
}
export function selectedCorrespondence(results:NormalizedSearchResult[],rootId:string,candidates:CorrespondenceCandidate[]){return candidates.filter(candidate=>candidate.sourceResultIds.includes(rootId)&&candidate.reviewState!=="rejected").map(candidate=>({...candidate,reviewState:candidate.confidenceClass==="deterministic"?"accepted":candidate.reviewState}));}

import type { LatticeHandoff } from "../contracts/handoff";
import type {
  InvestigationGraph,
  InvestigationSelection,
} from "../domain/model";
import type {
  CorrespondenceCandidate,
  FederatedSearchSnapshot,
  LatticeSource,
  NormalizedSearchResult,
  SourceSearchOutcome,
} from "./contracts";
export type InvestigationEntryMode =
  | "direct-discovery"
  | "contextual-handoff"
  | "restored-investigation";
export interface CanonicalSourceRecord {
  recordId: string;
  source: LatticeSource;
  nativeId: string;
  displayName: string;
  resultId?: string;
  selected: boolean;
  capabilities: string[];
  metadata: Record<string, string | number | boolean | null>;
}
export interface CanonicalInvestigation {
  investigationId: string;
  schemaVersion: 3;
  entryMode: InvestigationEntryMode;
  query?: string;
  rootContext: {
    label: string;
    primarySource?: LatticeSource;
    primaryNativeId?: string;
  };
  sourceRecords: CanonicalSourceRecord[];
  correspondenceRecords: CorrespondenceCandidate[];
  entities: InvestigationGraph["entities"];
  relationships: InvestigationGraph["relationships"];
  sourceOutcomes: Partial<Record<LatticeSource, SourceSearchOutcome>>;
  evidenceCoverage: Record<
    string,
    "available" | "partial" | "unavailable" | "not-requested"
  >;
  selection: InvestigationSelection;
  expansion: string[];
  filters: { sources: LatticeSource[]; relationships: string[] };
  activePath: string[];
  viewport: { x: number; y: number; zoom: number };
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
}
export function createDirectInvestigation(input: {
  selected: NormalizedSearchResult[];
  correspondences: CorrespondenceCandidate[];
  snapshot: FederatedSearchSnapshot;
  graph: InvestigationGraph;
}): CanonicalInvestigation {
  const primary = input.selected[0],
    timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  return {
    investigationId: `lattice-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
    schemaVersion: 3,
    entryMode: "direct-discovery",
    query: input.snapshot.request.query,
    rootContext: {
      label: primary.displayName,
      primarySource: primary.source,
      primaryNativeId: primary.nativeId,
    },
    sourceRecords: input.selected.map((result) => ({
      recordId: `${result.source}:${result.nativeId}`,
      source: result.source,
      nativeId: result.nativeId,
      displayName: result.displayName,
      resultId: result.resultId,
      selected: true,
      capabilities: result.capabilityHints,
      metadata: result.sourceMetadata,
    })),
    correspondenceRecords: input.correspondences,
    entities: input.graph.entities,
    relationships: input.graph.relationships,
    sourceOutcomes: input.snapshot.outcomes,
    evidenceCoverage: {
      structure: "available",
      requirements: "not-requested",
      changes: "not-requested",
      operations: "not-requested",
      configuration: "not-requested",
    },
    selection: { type: "none" },
    expansion: input.graph.roots,
    filters: {
      sources: [
        ...new Set(
          input.graph.entities
            .map((item) => item.source)
            .filter((item): item is LatticeSource => item !== "excel"),
        ),
      ],
      relationships: ["contains", "corresponds-to"],
    },
    activePath: [],
    viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
    createdAt: timestamp,
    updatedAt: timestamp,
  };
}
export function handoffInvestigationShell(
  handoff: LatticeHandoff,
  graph: InvestigationGraph,
): CanonicalInvestigation {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();
  return {

    schemaVersion: 3,
    entryMode: "contextual-handoff",
    rootContext: {
      label: handoff.subjectLabel,
      primarySource: handoff.sources[0]?.source as LatticeSource | undefined,
      primaryNativeId: handoff.sources[0]?.nativeId,
    },
    sourceRecords: handoff.sources
      .filter((item) => item.source !== "excel")

        recordId: `${item.source}:${item.nativeId ?? item.root.id}`,
        source: item.source as LatticeSource,
        nativeId: item.nativeId ?? item.root.id,
        displayName: item.root.name,
        selected: true,
        capabilities: [],
        metadata: {},
      })),
    correspondenceRecords: [],
    entities: graph.entities,
    relationships: graph.relationships,
    sourceOutcomes: {},
    evidenceCoverage: {
      structure: "available",
      requirements: "not-requested",
      changes: "not-requested",
      operations: "not-requested",
      configuration: "not-requested",
    },
    selection: { type: "none" },
    expansion: graph.roots,
    filters: {
      sources: handoff.sources
        .map((item) => item.source)
        .filter((item): item is LatticeSource => item !== "excel"),
      relationships: ["contains", "corresponds-to"],
    },
    activePath: [],
    viewport: { x: 0, y: 0, zoom: 1 },
    createdAt: timestamp,
    updatedAt: timestamp,
  };
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\discovery\query-intent.ts =====
import type { QueryIntent } from "./contracts";
export function normalizeQuery(value: string) { return value.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " "); }
export function classifyQueryIntent(value: string): QueryIntent {
  const query = normalizeQuery(value);
  if (!query) return "unknown";
  const looksLikeIdentifier = /^[A-Z0-9._:/-]+$/i.test(query) && /\d/.test(query);
  return looksLikeIdentifier ? "exact-engineering-id" : "product-name";
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\discovery\source-adapters\api-search-adapter.ts =====
import type { ItemSearchCandidate, SourceSearchResult } from "@/types/item-explorer";
import { SOURCE_CAPABILITIES } from "../capability-matrix";
import type { FederatedSearchRequest, LatticeSource, MatchCategory, NormalizedSearchResult, SourceSearchOutcome } from "../contracts";
import type { SourceSearchAdapter } from "./base";

function category(candidate: ItemSearchCandidate): MatchCategory {
  if (candidate.matchType === "exact-id") return candidate.providerMode === "live" ? "verified-identifier-match" : "source-native-reference";
  if (candidate.matchType === "exact-name") return "exact-normalized-name-match";
  if (candidate.matchType === "source-result" || candidate.matchType === "id-prefix") return "probable-match";
  return "ambiguous-candidate";
}

function normalize(source: LatticeSource, candidate: ItemSearchCandidate): NormalizedSearchResult {
  return {
    resultId: candidate.candidateId,
    source,
    nativeId: candidate.nativeId,
    displayName: candidate.name,
    entityType: candidate.context.objectType ?? "engineering-record",
    revision: candidate.context.revision,
    version: candidate.context.version,
    lifecycleState: candidate.context.lifecycleState,
    description: candidate.description,
    matchCategory: category(candidate),
    matchReason: candidate.matchReasons.join(" ") || "Returned by the source connector.",
    capabilityHints: [],
    sourceMetadata: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(candidate.context).filter((entry): entry is [string, string] => typeof entry[1] === "string")),
    provenance: {
      providerMode: candidate.providerMode === "live" ? "live" : "capability",
      retrievedAt: candidate.retrievedAt,
      sourceRoute: `/api/item-explorer/search/${source}`,
    },
    canStartInvestigation: Boolean(candidate.nativeId),
  };
}

export class ApiSearchAdapter implements SourceSearchAdapter {
  constructor(readonly source: LatticeSource) {}

  async search(request: FederatedSearchRequest, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<SourceSearchOutcome> {
    const started = Date.now();
    const startedAt = new Date(started).toISOString();
    const capability = SOURCE_CAPABILITIES[this.source];
    const mode = request.queryIntent === "product-name" && capability.supportsNameSearch ? "name" : "item-id";
    const response = await fetch(`/api/item-explorer/search/${this.source}?query=${encodeURIComponent(request.query)}&mode=${mode}&limit=${Math.min(request.resultLimitPerSource, capability.resultLimit)}`, { cache: "no-store", signal });
    let payload: SourceSearchResult;
    try { payload = await response.json() as SourceSearchResult; }
    catch { throw new Error(`${this.source} returned a malformed response.`); }
    const results = (payload.candidates ?? []).map((candidate) => normalize(this.source, candidate));
    const state = payload.status === "complete" ? (results.length ? "succeeded" : "empty") : payload.status === "empty" ? "empty" : payload.status === "unsupported" ? "unavailable" : payload.status === "timed-out" ? "timed-out" : payload.status === "cancelled" ? "cancelled" : "failed";
    return {
      source: this.source,
      requestId: request.requestId,
      status: state,
      results,
      startedAt,
      completedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      durationMs: Date.now() - started,
      warning: payload.capabilityNote,
      error: state === "failed" ? { code: "connector-error", message: payload.error ?? `${this.source} search failed.` } : undefined,
      retryable: state === "failed" || state === "timed-out",
      capabilitySnapshot: capability,
    };
  }
}

import type { LatticeSource,NormalizedSearchResult } from "./contracts";
import { resolveSelectedStructure,type ResolutionUpdate,type ResolvedStructure } from "./structure-resolver";
const limits:Record<LatticeSource,number>={sap:1,teamcenter:1,windchill:3,configit:2,codebeamer:2};
class Semaphore{private active=0;private queue:Array<()=>void>=[];constructor(private readonly limit:number){}async run<T>(work:()=>Promise<T>){if(this.active>=this.limit)await new Promise<void>(resolve=>this.queue.push(resolve));this.active++;try{return await work()}finally{this.active--;this.queue.shift()?.()}}}
export type ResolutionRecord={result:NormalizedSearchResult;outcome:ResolvedStructure};
export class StructureResolutionOrchestrator{private readonly gates=new Map<LatticeSource,Semaphore>(Object.entries(limits).map(([source,limit])=>[source as LatticeSource,new Semaphore(limit)]));private readonly controllers=new Map<string,AbortController>();cancel(resultId?:string){if(resultId){this.controllers.get(resultId)?.abort();this.controllers.delete(resultId);return}for(const controller of this.controllers.values())controller.abort();this.controllers.clear()}
 async resolveAll(results:NormalizedSearchResult[],onUpdate?:(update:ResolutionUpdate)=>void,onSettled?:(record:ResolutionRecord)=>void){const tasks=results.map(async result=>{const controller=new AbortController();this.controllers.set(result.resultId,controller);onUpdate?.({resultId:result.resultId,source:result.source,nativeId:result.nativeId,state:"queued",message:`Queued for ${result.source} extraction.`,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});const gate=this.gates.get(result.source)!;const outcome=await gate.run(()=>resolveSelectedStructure(result,controller.signal,onUpdate));this.controllers.delete(result.resultId);const record={result,outcome};onSettled?.(record);return record});return Promise.allSettled(tasks)}
}

import type { TreeNodeData } from "@/types/bom-comparison";
import { getConfigitRoot,getTeamcenterRoot,getWindchillRoot } from "@/components/BomStreamViewer";
import type { LatticeSource,NormalizedSearchResult } from "./contracts";
import { extractCodebeamerRequirement } from "./codebeamer-extraction";
const API_BASE=process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL||"http://localhost:5212/api";
const policy:Record<LatticeSource,{timeoutMs:number;pollMs:number}>={sap:{timeoutMs:330000,pollMs:2200},teamcenter:{timeoutMs:330000,pollMs:1800},windchill:{timeoutMs:300000,pollMs:0},configit:{timeoutMs:180000,pollMs:0},codebeamer:{timeoutMs:120000,pollMs:500}};
export type ResolutionState="queued"|"starting"|"extracting"|"ready"|"partial"|"failed"|"timed-out"|"cancelled";
export type ResolutionUpdate={resultId:string;source:LatticeSource;nativeId:string;state:ResolutionState;message:string;progressPercent?:number;jobId?:string;updatedAt:string};
export type ResolvedStructure={root:TreeNodeData;intelligencePayload?:Record<string,unknown>;warning?:string;jobId?:string;state:Extract<ResolutionState,"ready"|"partial"|"failed"|"timed-out"|"cancelled">};
const update=(result:NormalizedSearchResult,state:ResolutionState,message:string,extra:Partial<ResolutionUpdate>,notify?:(value:ResolutionUpdate)=>void)=>notify?.({resultId:result.resultId,source:result.source,nativeId:result.nativeId,state,message,updatedAt:new Date().toISOString(),...extra});
const sleep=(ms:number,signal:AbortSignal)=>new Promise<void>((resolve,reject)=>{const id=window.setTimeout(resolve,ms);signal.addEventListener("abort",()=>{window.clearTimeout(id);reject(new DOMException("Cancelled","AbortError"))},{once:true})});
function fallback(result:NormalizedSearchResult,state:ResolutionState,message:string):TreeNodeData{return{id:`${result.source}:${result.nativeId}`,name:result.displayName,attributes:{"Item ID":result.nativeId,"Resolution Status":state,"Resolution Message":message},children:[]}}
function record(value:unknown){return value&&typeof value==="object"&&!Array.isArray(value)?value as Record<string,unknown>:null}
function sapNode(value:unknown,path:string):TreeNodeData{const node=record(value)??{},material=String(node.itemId??node.id??path),children=Array.isArray(node.children)?node.children:[];return{id:`${path}:${material}`,name:String(node.name??material),attributes:{"Item ID":material,...(typeof node.qty==="string"?{Qty:node.qty}:{})},children:children.map((child,index)=>sapNode(child,`${path}.${index}`))}}
function sapRoot(payload:unknown){const body=record(payload),inner=record(body?.payload)??body,final=record(inner?.finalBom)??inner,root=record(final?.bomRoot)??record(final?.bomRootNode);return root?sapNode(root,"sap-root"):null}
function requestSignal(signal:AbortSignal,timeoutMs:number){return AbortSignal.any([signal,AbortSignal.timeout(timeoutMs)])}
function metadata(result:NormalizedSearchResult,key:string){const value=result.sourceMetadata[key];return typeof value==="string"&&value.trim()?value.trim():undefined}
async function startPipeline(result:NormalizedSearchResult,signal:AbortSignal,notify?:(value:ResolutionUpdate)=>void){const body=result.source==="sap"?{kind:"sap",materialId:result.nativeId,materialQuery:result.displayName,plant:metadata(result,"plant")??"1001",includeSapBusinessImpact:true}:{kind:"teamcenter",teamcenterItemId:result.nativeId};update(result,"starting",`Starting ${result.source} extraction.`,{},notify);const response=await fetch(`${API_BASE}/pipeline/start`,{method:"POST",headers:{"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(body),signal});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`${result.source} structure request could not start (${response.status}).`);const payload=await response.json() as {jobId?:string};if(!payload.jobId)throw new Error("Pipeline did not return a job ID.");return payload.jobId}
function monitorProgress(result:NormalizedSearchResult,jobId:string,signal:AbortSignal,notify?:(value:ResolutionUpdate)=>void){return new Promise<{terminal?:"complete"|"error";message?:string}>((resolve)=>{let settled=false;const source=new EventSource(`${API_BASE}/pipeline/progress/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`),finish=(value:{terminal?:"complete"|"error";message?:string})=>{if(settled)return;settled=true;source.close();resolve(value)},abort=()=>finish({message:"Cancelled"});signal.addEventListener("abort",abort,{once:true});source.onmessage=event=>{try{const progress=JSON.parse(event.data) as {status?:string;phase?:string;progressPercent?:number;message?:string;error?:string};update(result,"extracting",progress.message??`Extracting from ${result.source}.`,{jobId,progressPercent:progress.progressPercent},notify);if(progress.status==="error"||progress.error)finish({terminal:"error",message:progress.error??progress.message});else if(progress.status==="complete"||progress.progressPercent===100)finish({terminal:"complete",message:progress.message})}catch{}};source.onerror=()=>finish({message:"Progress stream unavailable; continuing with result polling."});window.setTimeout(()=>finish({message:"Progress monitoring switched to result polling."}),Math.min(policy[result.source].timeoutMs,300000))})}
async function pipeline(result:NormalizedSearchResult,signal:AbortSignal,notify?:(value:ResolutionUpdate)=>void){
 const jobId=await startPipeline(result,signal,notify),started=Date.now();void monitorProgress(result,jobId,signal,notify);let misses=0;
 while(Date.now()-started<policy[result.source].timeoutMs){
  if(signal.aborted)throw new DOMException("Cancelled","AbortError");
  const bom=await fetch(`${API_BASE}/pipeline/bom/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`,{cache:"no-store",signal});
  if(bom.ok)return{payload:await bom.json(),jobId,operational:false};
  if(result.source==="sap"){
   const operational=await fetch(`${API_BASE}/pipeline/sap-operational-impact/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`,{cache:"no-store",signal});
   if(operational.ok)return{payload:null,jobId,operational:true};
   const statusResponse=await fetch(`${API_BASE}/pipeline/status/${encodeURIComponent(jobId)}`,{cache:"no-store",signal});
   if(statusResponse.ok){const status=await statusResponse.json() as {terminal?:boolean;status?:string;error?:string};if(status.terminal){if(String(status.status).startsWith("failed"))throw new Error(status.error||"SAP extraction failed.");throw new Error("SAP completed without BOM or operational intelligence.")}}
  }
  if(bom.status!==404&&bom.status!==202){if(bom.status>=500&&misses++<3){await sleep(Math.min(8000,1000*2**misses),signal);continue}throw new Error(`${result.source} structure request failed (${bom.status}).`)}
  update(result,"extracting",misses?`Waiting for ${result.source}; retrying result retrieval.`:`${result.source} extraction is still running.`,{jobId},notify);await sleep(policy[result.source].pollMs,signal)
 }
 throw new DOMException(`${result.source} structure resolution exceeded ${Math.round(policy[result.source].timeoutMs/1000)} seconds. The backend job may still be running.`,"TimeoutError")
}
export async function resolveSelectedStructure(result:NormalizedSearchResult,signal:AbortSignal,notify?:(value:ResolutionUpdate)=>void):Promise<ResolvedStructure>{try{update(result,"extracting",`Resolving ${result.displayName}.`,{},notify);if(result.source==="codebeamer")return await extractCodebeamerRequirement(result,signal,notify);if(result.source==="windchill"){const response=await fetch(`/api/bom-windchill?partId=${encodeURIComponent(result.nativeId)}`,{cache:"no-store",signal:requestSignal(signal,policy.windchill.timeoutMs)});if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`Windchill extraction failed (${response.status}).`);const root=getWindchillRoot(await response.json());if(!root)throw new Error("Windchill returned no usable structure.");update(result,"ready","Windchill structure ready.",{progressPercent:100},notify);return{root,state:"ready"}}if(result.source==="configit"){const queryValue=metadata(result,"query")??metadata(result,"workItemName")??result.displayName??result.nativeId;const response=await fetch(`/api/bom-configit?query=${encodeURIComponent(queryValue)}`,{cache:"no-store",signal:requestSignal(signal,policy.configit.timeoutMs)});const payload=await response.json() as Record<string,unknown>;if(!response.ok)throw new Error(`Configit extraction failed (${response.status}).`);const root=getConfigitRoot(payload)??{id:`configit:${result.nativeId}`,name:result.displayName,attributes:{"Item ID":result.nativeId,"Authoring Only":true},children:[]};const partial=payload.status==="partial_success";update(result,partial?"partial":"ready",partial?"Configit authoring data ready with partial package coverage.":"Configit intelligence ready.",{progressPercent:100},notify);return{root,intelligencePayload:payload,warning:partial?"Configit returned partial source coverage.":undefined,state:partial?"partial":"ready"}}const {payload,jobId,operational}=await pipeline(result,signal,notify),root=result.source==="sap"?sapRoot(payload):getTeamcenterRoot(payload);
if(result.source==="sap"&&operational){const message="SAP operational intelligence is ready; no SAP BOM was available.";update(result,"partial",message,{jobId,progressPercent:100},notify);return{root:fallback(result,"partial",message),warning:message,jobId,state:"partial"}}if(!root){const message=`${result.source} completed without a usable structure.`;update(result,"partial",message,{jobId,progressPercent:100},notify);return{root:fallback(result,"partial",message),warning:message,jobId,state:"partial"}}update(result,"ready",`${result.source} structure ready.`,{jobId,progressPercent:100},notify);return{root,jobId,state:"ready"}}catch(cause){const aborted=cause instanceof DOMException&&cause.name==="AbortError",timedOut=cause instanceof DOMException&&cause.name==="TimeoutError",state=aborted?"cancelled":timedOut?"timed-out":"failed",message=cause instanceof Error?cause.message:"Structure is temporarily unavailable.";update(result,state,message,{},notify);return{root:fallback(result,state,message),warning:message,state}}}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\frontend\features\lattice-next\kernel\adapters\current-source-execution-adapter.ts =====
import type { LatticeHandoff } from "../../contracts/handoff";
import type { NormalizedSearchResult } from "../../discovery/contracts";
import { resolveSelectedStructure } from "../../discovery/structure-resolver";
import { investigateConfigit } from "../../infrastructure/configit-intelligence-client";
import { investigateSap } from "../../infrastructure/sap-intelligence-client";
import { investigateWindchill } from "../../infrastructure/windchill-intelligence-client";
import { projectCodebeamerIntelligence } from "../../engines/project-codebeamer-intelligence";
import type { SourceOperationCommand, SourceOperationError } from "../contracts/source-operation";
import type { SourceOperationResult } from "../contracts/source-operation-result";
import type { SourceExecutionPort } from "../ports/source-execution-port";
import {
  rejectedEvidenceResult,
  wrapCurrentIntelligenceEvidence,
  wrapCurrentStructureEvidence,
} from "./current-evidence-adapter";

export interface CurrentHandoffProvider {
  getHandoff(command: SourceOperationCommand): Promise<LatticeHandoff | undefined>;
}

const currentSources = new Set(["sap", "teamcenter", "windchill", "configit", "codebeamer"]);

function toSearchResult(command: SourceOperationCommand): NormalizedSearchResult {
  const selection = command.selection;
  if (!currentSources.has(selection.source))
    throw new Error(`Unsupported current source: ${selection.source}`);
  const metadata = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(selection.metadata ?? {}).map(([key, value]) => [key, value]),
  );
  return {
    resultId: metadata.candidateId ?? metadata.canonicalId ?? `${selection.source}:${selection.nativeId}`,
    source: selection.source as NormalizedSearchResult["source"],
    nativeId: selection.nativeId,
    displayName: selection.displayName,
    entityType: metadata.entityType ?? "engineering-item",
    matchCategory: "source-native-reference",
    matchReason: "Selected source identity supplied by the Investigation Kernel.",
    capabilityHints: [],
    sourceMetadata: metadata,
    provenance: {
      providerMode: "capability",
      retrievedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      sourceRoute: "investigation-kernel/current-source-execution-adapter",
    },
    canStartInvestigation: true,
  };
}

function operationError(cause: unknown, aborted: boolean): SourceOperationError {
  const message = cause instanceof Error ? cause.message : "Source operation failed.";
  if (aborted)
    return { code: "source-cancelled", message, retryable: false };
  if (/timeout|timed out|exceeded/i.test(message))
    return { code: "source-timeout", message, retryable: true };
  if (/unauthor|forbidden/i.test(message))
    return { code: "authorization-failed", message, retryable: false };
  if (/authentication|sign.?in|login/i.test(message))
    return { code: "authentication-failed", message, retryable: false };
  if (/not found|no .* source|no usable/i.test(message))
    return { code: "not-found", message, retryable: false };
  if (/invalid .*contract|malformed/i.test(message))
    return { code: "contract-invalid", message, retryable: false };
  return { code: "unknown", message, retryable: true };
}

const completedObservation = (value: string | undefined): string => value ?? new Date().toISOString();

export class CurrentSourceExecutionAdapter implements SourceExecutionPort {
  private readonly resolvedStructures = new Map<string, { value: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof resolveSelectedStructure>>; observedAt: string }>();

  constructor(private readonly handoffs: CurrentHandoffProvider) {}

  private structureKey(source: string, nativeId: string): string {
    return `${source}:${nativeId}`;
  }

  resolvedHandoff(investigationId: string, subjectLabel: string, selections: readonly { source: string; nativeId: string }[]): LatticeHandoff | undefined {
    const sources = selections.flatMap((selection) => {
      const cached = this.resolvedStructures.get(this.structureKey(selection.source, selection.nativeId));
      if (!cached) return [];
      return [{
        source: selection.source as LatticeHandoff["sources"][number]["source"],
        label: selection.source,
        root: cached.value.root,
        nativeId: selection.nativeId,
        jobId: cached.value.jobId,
        capturedAt: cached.observedAt,
        completeness: cached.value.state === "ready" ? "complete" as const : "partial" as const,
        intelligencePayload: cached.value.intelligencePayload,
      }];
    });
    if (!sources.length) return undefined;
    const createdAt = new Date().toISOString();
    return {
      version: 2,
      handoffId: investigationId,
      createdAt,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(createdAt) + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      subjectLabel,
      sources,
    };
  }

  private cachedHandoff(command: SourceOperationCommand): LatticeHandoff | undefined {
    const cached = this.resolvedStructures.get(this.structureKey(command.selection.source, command.selection.nativeId));
    if (!cached) return undefined;
    return {
      version: 2,
      handoffId: String(command.identity.investigationId),
      createdAt: cached.observedAt,
      expiresAt: new Date(Date.parse(cached.observedAt) + 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
      subjectLabel: command.selection.displayName,
      sources: [{
        source: command.selection.source as LatticeHandoff["sources"][number]["source"],
        label: command.selection.source,
        root: cached.value.root,
        nativeId: command.selection.nativeId,
        jobId: cached.value.jobId,
        capturedAt: cached.observedAt,
        completeness: cached.value.state === "ready" ? "complete" : "partial",
        intelligencePayload: cached.value.intelligencePayload,
      }],
    };
  }

  async execute(command: SourceOperationCommand): Promise<SourceOperationResult> {
    const startedAt = new Date().toISOString();
    try {
      if (command.identity.operation === "resolve-structure") {
        const resolved = await resolveSelectedStructure(
          toSearchResult(command),
          command.signal,
        );
        const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        if (resolved.state === "ready" || resolved.state === "partial") {
          this.resolvedStructures.set(this.structureKey(command.selection.source, command.selection.nativeId), { value: resolved, observedAt: completedAt });
        }
        const evidence = wrapCurrentStructureEvidence(resolved, {
          identity: command.identity,
          observedAt: completedAt,
          warnings: resolved.warning ? [resolved.warning] : [],
        });
        const status = resolved.state === "ready"
          ? "succeeded"
          : resolved.state === "partial"
            ? "partial"
            : resolved.state;
        return {
          identity: command.identity,
          status,
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
          evidence,
          warnings: evidence.warnings,
          error: evidence.validation.status === "rejected"
            ? {
                code: resolved.state === "timed-out" ? "source-timeout" : resolved.state === "cancelled" ? "source-cancelled" : "unknown",
                message: resolved.warning ?? `Structure resolution ${resolved.state}.`,
                retryable: resolved.state === "timed-out" || resolved.state === "failed",
              }
            : undefined,
        };
      }

      const handoff = await this.handoffs.getHandoff(command) ?? this.cachedHandoff(command);
      if (!handoff) {
        const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
        return rejectedEvidenceResult(
          command.identity,
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          "Current intelligence execution requires a source handoff.",
        );
      }
      const current = handoff.sources.some((item) => item.source === command.selection.source)
        ? { ...handoff, sources: handoff.sources.filter((item) => item.source === command.selection.source) }
        : handoff;
      const value = command.selection.source === "windchill"
        ? await investigateWindchill(current, command.signal)
        : command.selection.source === "sap"
          ? await investigateSap(current, command.signal)
          : command.selection.source === "configit"
            ? await investigateConfigit(current, command.signal)
            : command.selection.source === "codebeamer"
              ? projectCodebeamerIntelligence(
                  String(command.identity.investigationId),
                  this.resolvedStructures.get(this.structureKey(command.selection.source, command.selection.nativeId))?.value,
                  completedObservation(this.resolvedStructures.get(this.structureKey(command.selection.source, command.selection.nativeId))?.observedAt),
                )
              : undefined;
      const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      if (!value)
        return {
          identity: command.identity,
          status: "empty",
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
          warnings: [`No current intelligence client is registered for ${command.selection.source}.`],
        };
      const evidence = wrapCurrentIntelligenceEvidence(value, {
        identity: command.identity,
        observedAt: completedAt,
      });
      if (evidence.validation.status === "rejected")
        return rejectedEvidenceResult(
          command.identity,
          startedAt,
          completedAt,
          "Current intelligence response failed contract validation.",
        );
      const sourceState = value.sources.find((item) => item.source === command.selection.source)?.status;
      const status = sourceState === "partial" || sourceState === "capability-limited"
        ? "partial"
        : sourceState === "unavailable"
          ? "unavailable"
          : sourceState === "timed-out"
            ? "timed-out"
            : sourceState === "cancelled"
              ? "cancelled"
              : sourceState === "failed"
                ? "failed"
                : "succeeded";
      return {
        identity: command.identity,
        status,
        startedAt,
        completedAt,
        durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
        evidence,
        warnings: evidence.warnings,
      };
    } catch (cause) {
      const completedAt = new Date().toISOString();
      const error = operationError(cause, command.signal.aborted);
      return {
        identity: command.identity,
        status: error.code === "source-cancelled" ? "cancelled" : error.code === "source-timeout" ? "timed-out" : "failed",
        startedAt,
        completedAt,
        durationMs: Math.max(0, Date.parse(completedAt) - Date.parse(startedAt)),
        warnings: [],
        error,
      };
    }
  }
}

import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { projectCodebeamerIntelligence } from "../engines/project-codebeamer-intelligence";
import { mergeSourceIntelligence } from "../infrastructure/merge-source-intelligence";

const payload = (id: number, customName: string) => ({
  intelligencePayload: {
    sourceExecutionId: `execution-${id}`,
    status: "success",
    evidence: {
      requirement: { canonicalId: `codebeamer:test:item:${id}`, itemId: id, externalKey: `REQ-${id}`, name: `Requirement ${id}`, status: "New", version: 1 },
      sourceContext: { projectId: 9, projectName: "Project", trackerId: 11, trackerName: "Requirements" },
      hierarchy: { parentName: null, childNames: [] },
      catalog: { revision: "revision", status: "complete", synchronizedAt: "2026-10-19T00:00:00Z" },
      liveEnrichment: {
        contractVersion: "2.0", status: "complete", retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:00Z",
        item: { status: "loaded", count: 1, retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:00Z", failures: [], data: { id, name: `Requirement ${id}`, typeName: "Requirement", customFields: [{ id: 81, name: customName, value: `Value ${id}` }] } },
        relations: { status: "loaded-empty", count: 0, retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:01Z", failures: [], data: {} },
        attachments: { status: "loaded-empty", count: 0, retrievedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:02Z", failures: [], data: {} },
        failures: [],
      },
    },
    provenance: { provider: "codebeamer_extractor", observedAt: "2026-10-19T00:01:00Z" },
  },
});

describe("L-CB5C Codebeamer details projection", () => {
  it("preserves complete live evidence and loaded-empty semantics", () => {
    const result = projectCodebeamerIntelligence("investigation", payload(101, "Arbitrary Field"), "2026-10-19T00:02:00Z")!;
    const entity = result.entities.find((item) => item.id === "codebeamer:test:item:101")!;
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.contractVersion"].text).toBe("2.0");
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.item.status"].text).toBe("loaded");
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.relations.status"].text).toBe("loaded-empty");
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.evidence.attachments.count"].number).toBe(0);
    expect(entity.properties["codebeamer.custom.Arbitrary Field"].text).toContain("Value 101");
  });

  it("keeps evidence isolated for multiple requirements", () => {
    const first = projectCodebeamerIntelligence("first", payload(101, "Field A"), "2026-10-19T00:02:00Z")!;
    const second = projectCodebeamerIntelligence("second", payload(202, "Field B"), "2026-10-19T00:02:00Z")!;
    const merged = mergeSourceIntelligence([first, second]);
    const a = merged.entities.find((item) => item.id === "codebeamer:test:item:101")!;
    const b = merged.entities.find((item) => item.id === "codebeamer:test:item:202")!;
    expect(a.properties["codebeamer.custom.Field A"].text).toContain("101");
    expect(a.properties["codebeamer.custom.Field B"]).toBeUndefined();
    expect(b.properties["codebeamer.custom.Field B"].text).toContain("202");
  });
});

using System.Diagnostics;using System.Text.Json;using System.Text.Json.Serialization;using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
namespace Orchestration.API.Engineering.Adapters.Codebeamer;
public interface ICodebeamerCliClient { Task<CodebeamerStatusDto> StatusAsync(CancellationToken token); Task<CodebeamerSearchDto> SearchAsync(string query,int limit,CancellationToken token); Task<CodebeamerEnrichmentDto> EnrichAsync(int itemId,CancellationToken token); }
public sealed class CodebeamerCliClient:ICodebeamerCliClient
{
 readonly CodebeamerOptions options;static readonly JsonSerializerOptions Json=new(){PropertyNameCaseInsensitive=true,PropertyNamingPolicy=JsonNamingPolicy.SnakeCaseLower};public CodebeamerCliClient(IOptions<CodebeamerOptions> options)=>this.options=options.Value;
 public async Task<CodebeamerStatusDto> StatusAsync(CancellationToken token)=>Deserialize<CodebeamerStatusDto>(await RunAsync(["status","--json"],token));public async Task<CodebeamerSearchDto> SearchAsync(string query,int limit,CancellationToken token)=>Deserialize<CodebeamerSearchDto>(await RunAsync(["search",query,"--limit",Math.Clamp(limit,1,500).ToString(),"--json"],token));public async Task<CodebeamerEnrichmentDto> EnrichAsync(int itemId,CancellationToken token)=>Deserialize<CodebeamerEnrichmentDto>(await RunAsync(["enrich",itemId.ToString()],token,new HashSet<int> { 0, 1 }));T Deserialize<T>(string value)=>JsonSerializer.Deserialize<T>(value,Json)??throw new InvalidOperationException("Codebeamer returned an empty JSON contract.");
 async Task<string> RunAsync(IReadOnlyList<string> args,CancellationToken token,IReadOnlySet<int>? acceptedExitCodes=null)
 {
  acceptedExitCodes ??= new HashSet<int>{0};
  var working=Path.GetFullPath(options.WorkingDirectory);
  if(!Directory.Exists(working))throw new DirectoryNotFoundException($"Codebeamer extractor directory was not found: {working}");
  var exe=options.ExecutablePath;
  if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(exe))exe=OperatingSystem.IsWindows()?Path.Combine(working,".venv","Scripts","codebeamer-extractor.exe"):Path.Combine(working,".venv","bin","codebeamer-extractor");
  if(!File.Exists(exe))throw new FileNotFoundException("Codebeamer extractor executable was not found.",exe);
  using var p=new Process{StartInfo=new ProcessStartInfo{FileName=exe,WorkingDirectory=working,RedirectStandardOutput=true,RedirectStandardError=true,UseShellExecute=false,CreateNoWindow=true}};
  foreach(var a in args)p.StartInfo.ArgumentList.Add(a);
  if(!p.Start())throw new InvalidOperationException("Codebeamer extractor process could not be started.");
  using var timeout=new CancellationTokenSource(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(Math.Clamp(options.CommandTimeoutSeconds,1,300)));
  using var linked=CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(token,timeout.Token);
  var stdoutTask=p.StandardOutput.ReadToEndAsync(linked.Token);var stderrTask=p.StandardError.ReadToEndAsync(linked.Token);
  try{await p.WaitForExitAsync(linked.Token);}catch{try{p.Kill(true);}catch{}throw;}
  var output=await stdoutTask;var error=await stderrTask;
  if(output.Length>options.MaximumOutputCharacters)throw new InvalidOperationException("Codebeamer output exceeded the configured safety limit.");
  if(!acceptedExitCodes.Contains(p.ExitCode))
  {
   var diagnostic=Sanitize(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(error)?output:error);
   throw new InvalidOperationException($"Codebeamer command '{args[0]}' failed with exit code {p.ExitCode}: {diagnostic}");
  }
  if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(output))throw new InvalidOperationException($"Codebeamer command '{args[0]}' returned no JSON output.");
  return output;
 }
 static string Sanitize(string value)
 {
  var compact=value.Replace("\r"," ").Replace("\n"," ").Trim();
  if(compact.Length>2000)compact=compact[..2000];
  return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(compact)?"No diagnostic output was returned.":compact;
 }
}

public sealed record CodebeamerSearchDto(string Query,string NormalizedQuery,string CatalogRevision,string CatalogStatus,DateTimeOffset CatalogSynchronizedAt,int CatalogRequirementCount,IReadOnlyList<CodebeamerMatchDto> Matches);

Status,string? Priority,IReadOnlyList<string> Categories,IReadOnlyList<string> Severities,string? ParentName,IReadOnlyList<string> ChildNames,int? Version,bool Stale,int Score,string Classification,IReadOnlyList<string> MatchedFields,string Explanation);

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\Orchestration.API\Engineering\Adapters\Codebeamer\CodebeamerEngineeringAdapter.cs =====
using Orchestration.API.Engineering.Contracts;

namespace Orchestration.API.Engineering.Adapters.Codebeamer;

public sealed class CodebeamerEngineeringAdapter : IEngineeringSourceAdapter
{
    private readonly ICodebeamerCliClient client;
    public CodebeamerEngineeringAdapter(ICodebeamerCliClient client) => this.client = client;
    public EngineeringSource Source => EngineeringSource.Codebeamer;

    public async Task<SourceCapability> GetCapabilitiesAsync(CancellationToken token)
    {
        var status = await client.StatusAsync(token);
        return Capability(status.Status == "complete" ? SourceReadiness.Ready : SourceReadiness.Degraded);
    }

    public async Task<SourceDiscoveryOutcome> DiscoverAsync(EngineeringDiscoveryRequest request, QueryNormalizationRecord normalized, CancellationToken token)
    {
        SourceCapability capability;
        try { capability = await GetCapabilitiesAsync(token); }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
        catch (Exception ex) { return DiscoveryFailure("CODEBEAMER_STATUS_FAILED", ex.Message); }

        var query = !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.Query.ProductName) ? request.Query.ProductName : normalized.NormalizedValue;
        if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query)) return new(Source, StandardStatus.Empty, capability, [], [], [], false);
        try
        {
            var response = await client.SearchAsync(query, request.ResultLimitPerSource, token);
            var candidates = response.Matches.Select(x => Candidate(x, response)).ToList();
            return new(Source, candidates.Count == 0 ? StandardStatus.Empty : StandardStatus.Success, capability, candidates, [], [], false);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
        catch (Exception ex) { return DiscoveryFailure("CODEBEAMER_DISCOVERY_FAILED", ex.Message, capability); }
    }

    public async Task<StandardExtractionResult> ExtractAsync(string jobId, EngineeringExtractionRequest request, IProgress<StandardProgress> progress, CancellationToken token)
    {
        var started = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        var capability = Capability(SourceReadiness.Ready);
        progress.Report(Progress(jobId, JobState.Resolving, 10, "Resolving the selected Codebeamer requirement from the synchronized catalog."));
        try
        {
            var lookup = ResolveLookup(request.Candidate);
            var response = await client.SearchAsync(lookup, 50, token);
            var match = response.Matches.FirstOrDefault(x =>
                string.Equals(x.CanonicalId, request.Candidate.CandidateId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                string.Equals(x.ExternalKey, request.Candidate.SourceMetadata.GetValueOrDefault("externalKey"), StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ||
                string.Equals(x.ItemId.ToString(), request.Candidate.NativeId, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase));
            if (match is null) return Failure(jobId, request, started, capability, "CODEBEAMER_REQUIREMENT_NOT_FOUND", "The selected Codebeamer requirement is not present in the verified local catalog.", false, StandardStatus.Empty);

            progress.Report(Progress(jobId, JobState.Enriching, 55, "Retrieving live Codebeamer item, relation, and attachment evidence."));
            var enrichment = await client.EnrichAsync(match.ItemId, token);
            progress.Report(Progress(jobId, JobState.Enriching, 75, "Mapping catalog and live Codebeamer evidence without overwriting either observation."));
            var candidate = Candidate(match, response);
            var evidence = new Dictionary<string, object?>
            {
                ["requirement"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
                {
                    ["canonicalId"] = match.CanonicalId, ["itemId"] = match.ItemId, ["externalKey"] = match.ExternalKey,
                    ["name"] = match.Name, ["description"] = match.Description, ["status"] = match.Status,
                    ["priority"] = match.Priority, ["categories"] = match.Categories, ["severities"] = match.Severities,
                    ["version"] = match.Version, ["stale"] = match.Stale
                },
                ["sourceContext"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
                {
                    ["projectId"] = match.ProjectId, ["projectName"] = match.ProjectName,
                    ["trackerId"] = match.TrackerId, ["trackerName"] = match.TrackerName
                },
                ["hierarchy"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
                {
                    ["parentName"] = match.ParentName, ["childNames"] = match.ChildNames
                },
                ["catalog"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
                {
                    ["revision"] = response.CatalogRevision, ["status"] = response.CatalogStatus,
                    ["synchronizedAt"] = response.CatalogSynchronizedAt, ["requirementCount"] = response.CatalogRequirementCount
                },
                ["liveEnrichment"] = new Dictionary<string, object?>
                {
                    ["contractVersion"] = enrichment.ContractVersion,
                    ["status"] = enrichment.Status,
                    ["retrievedAt"] = enrichment.RetrievedAt,
                    ["item"] = Section(enrichment.Item),
                    ["relations"] = Section(enrichment.Relations),
                    ["attachments"] = Section(enrichment.Attachments),
                    ["failures"] = enrichment.Failures
                }
            };
            var partial = string.Equals(enrichment.Status, "partial-success", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            var finalStatus = partial ? StandardStatus.PartialSuccess : StandardStatus.Success;
            var warnings = enrichment.Failures.Select(f => new StructuredWarning(
                "CODEBEAMER_ENRICHMENT_SECTION_FAILED", Source, EngineeringStage.Enrichment,
                $"{f.Stage}: {f.Message}", DateTimeOffset.UtcNow,
                new Dictionary<string,string> { ["classification"] = f.Classification, ["retryable"] = f.Retryable.ToString() })).ToList();
            var completed = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
            var finalProgress = Progress(jobId, partial ? JobState.PartialSuccess : JobState.Success, 100, partial ? "Codebeamer extraction completed with partial live enrichment." : "Codebeamer catalog and live enrichment completed.");
            progress.Report(finalProgress);
            return new(EngineeringContractVersions.V1, request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, jobId, Source, finalStatus,
                new(finalStatus, candidate, match.CanonicalId, warnings, []), capability, null, [], evidence, warnings, [], finalProgress, [],
                new(ProvenanceKind.LiveSource, "codebeamer_extractor", enrichment.RetrievedAt, match.CanonicalId),
                [new(EngineeringStage.Resolution, EvidenceAvailability.Available, StandardStatus.Success, "The selected Codebeamer requirement was resolved from the verified catalog."), new(EngineeringStage.Enrichment, partial ? EvidenceAvailability.Partial : EvidenceAvailability.Available, finalStatus, partial ? "Live Codebeamer item evidence was accepted with optional-section limitations." : "Live Codebeamer item, relation, and attachment evidence were accepted.")],
                started, completed, (long)(completed - started).TotalMilliseconds);
        }
        catch (OperationCanceledException) { throw; }
        catch (Exception ex) { return Failure(jobId, request, started, capability, "CODEBEAMER_EXTRACTION_FAILED", ex.Message, true); }
    }

    private static string ResolveLookup(SourceCandidate candidate)
    {
        if (candidate.SourceMetadata.TryGetValue("externalKey", out var externalKey) && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(externalKey)) return externalKey;
        if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(candidate.DisplayName)) return candidate.DisplayName;
        return candidate.NativeId;
    }

    private static SourceCandidate Candidate(CodebeamerMatchDto x, CodebeamerSearchDto response) => new(
        x.CanonicalId, EngineeringSource.Codebeamer, x.ItemId.ToString(), x.Name, "Requirement", null, x.Version?.ToString(), x.Description, x.Status,
        x.Score >= 90 ? MatchCategory.VerifiedIdentifierMatch : x.Score >= 70 ? MatchCategory.ExactNormalizedNameMatch : MatchCategory.SourceSearchResult,
        x.Explanation, x.Score >= 90 ? ConfidenceClass.Verified : x.Score >= 60 ? ConfidenceClass.Deterministic : ConfidenceClass.Probable,
        ["requirements", "hierarchy", "local-search", "selected-requirement-extraction"],
        new Dictionary<string, string?> { ["externalKey"] = x.ExternalKey, ["projectId"] = x.ProjectId.ToString(), ["projectName"] = x.ProjectName, ["trackerId"] = x.TrackerId.ToString(), ["trackerName"] = x.TrackerName, ["classification"] = x.Classification, ["score"] = x.Score.ToString(), ["matchedFields"] = string.Join(",", x.MatchedFields), ["catalogRevision"] = response.CatalogRevision, ["catalogStatus"] = response.CatalogStatus, ["catalogSynchronizedAt"] = response.CatalogSynchronizedAt.ToString("O"), ["stale"] = x.Stale.ToString() },
        new(ProvenanceKind.CachedSourceResult, "codebeamer_extractor", response.CatalogSynchronizedAt, x.CanonicalId), true);


    private static IReadOnlyDictionary<string, object?> Section(CodebeamerEvidenceSectionDto section) => new Dictionary<string, object?>
    {
        ["status"] = section.Status,
        ["retrievedAt"] = section.RetrievedAt,
        ["count"] = section.Count,
        ["data"] = section.Data,
        ["failures"] = section.Failures
    };

    private static StandardExtractionResult Failure(string id, EngineeringExtractionRequest request, DateTimeOffset started, SourceCapability capability, string code, string message, bool retryable, StandardStatus status = StandardStatus.Failed)
    {
        var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow; var error = new StructuredError(code, EngineeringSource.Codebeamer, EngineeringStage.Extraction, message, "The selected Codebeamer requirement could not be extracted.", retryable, now);
        var state = status == StandardStatus.Empty ? JobState.Empty : JobState.Failed;
        return new(EngineeringContractVersions.V1, request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, id, EngineeringSource.Codebeamer, status, new(status, request.Candidate, null, [], [error]), capability, null, [], new Dictionary<string, object?>(), [], [error], Progress(id, state, 100, message), [], new(ProvenanceKind.Unavailable, "codebeamer_extractor", now), [new(EngineeringStage.Extraction, EvidenceAvailability.Unavailable, status, message)], started, now, (long)(now - started).TotalMilliseconds);
    }

    private SourceDiscoveryOutcome DiscoveryFailure(string code, string message, SourceCapability? capability = null) => new(Source, StandardStatus.Unavailable, capability ?? Capability(SourceReadiness.Unavailable), [], [], [new(code, Source, EngineeringStage.Discovery, message, "Codebeamer requirement discovery is currently unavailable.", true, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow)], true);
    private static StandardProgress Progress(string id, JobState state, int percent, string message) => new(id, EngineeringSource.Codebeamer, EngineeringStage.Extraction, state, percent, message, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow);
    private static SourceCapability Capability(SourceReadiness readiness) => new(EngineeringSource.Codebeamer, readiness, [DiscoveryMode.ExactId, DiscoveryMode.Name, DiscoveryMode.Number], true, true, true, true, true, false, true, false, false, true, true, true, [], ["Discovery and selected-requirement extraction use the synchronized local Codebeamer catalog.", "Live synchronization and relation enrichment are managed separately."]);
}

===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\Orchestration.API\Engineering\Services\EngineeringCancellationRegistry.cs =====
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Orchestration.API.Engineering.Contracts;
namespace Orchestration.API.Engineering.Services;
public interface IEngineeringCancellationRegistry { CancellationToken Register(string jobId,CancellationToken request,TimeSpan timeout); CancellationOutcome Cancel(string jobId); bool WasTimedOut(string jobId); void Complete(string jobId); }
public sealed class EngineeringCancellationRegistry:IEngineeringCancellationRegistry,IDisposable {
 sealed class Registration:IDisposable { public CancellationTokenSource Timeout {get;} public CancellationTokenSource Manual {get;} public CancellationTokenSource Linked {get;} public Registration(CancellationToken request,TimeSpan timeout){Timeout=new(timeout);Manual=new();Linked=CancellationTokenSource.CreateLinkedTokenSource(request,Timeout.Token,Manual.Token);} public void Dispose(){Linked.Dispose();Manual.Dispose();Timeout.Dispose();} }
 readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string,Registration> registrations=new(); readonly IEngineeringJobStore jobs;
 public EngineeringCancellationRegistry(IEngineeringJobStore jobs)=>this.jobs=jobs;
 public CancellationToken Register(string id,CancellationToken request,TimeSpan timeout){var registration=new Registration(request,timeout);if(!registrations.TryAdd(id,registration)){registration.Dispose();throw new InvalidOperationException("Cancellation registration already exists.");}return registration.Linked.Token;}
 public CancellationOutcome Cancel(string id){if(!jobs.TryGet(id,out var job)||job is null)return new(id,"job-not-found","Job was not found.",false);if(job.State is JobState.Success or JobState.PartialSuccess or JobState.Empty or JobState.Failed or JobState.Unavailable or JobState.TimedOut)return new(id,"job-already-completed","Completed jobs cannot be cancelled.",false);if(job.State is JobState.Cancelled or JobState.CancellationRequested)return new(id,"job-already-cancelled","Cancellation was already requested.",false);if(!registrations.TryGetValue(id,out var registration))return new(id,"cancellation-unsupported","The active source execution has no cancellation registration.",false);jobs.TryTransition(id,JobState.CancellationRequested,EngineeringStage.Cancellation,job.ProgressPercent,"cancellation-requested");try{registration.Manual.Cancel();return new(id,"cancellation-accepted","Cancellation was accepted.",true);}catch{return new(id,"cancellation-failed","Cancellation could not be completed safely.",false);}}
 public bool WasTimedOut(string id)=>registrations.TryGetValue(id,out var registration)&&registration.Timeout.IsCancellationRequested;
 public void Complete(string id){if(registrations.TryRemove(id,out var registration))registration.Dispose();}
 public void Dispose(){foreach(var id in registrations.Keys)Complete(id);}
}

using Orchestration.API.Engineering.Adapters;
using Orchestration.API.Engineering.Contracts;
namespace Orchestration.API.Engineering.Services;

public interface IEngineeringExecutionService { Task<EngineeringDiscoveryResult> DiscoverAsync(EngineeringDiscoveryRequest request, CancellationToken token); EngineeringJobRecord StartExtraction(EngineeringExtractionRequest request, CancellationToken requestToken); }
public sealed class EngineeringExecutionService : IEngineeringExecutionService
{
    readonly IEngineeringAdapterRegistry registry; readonly IEngineeringRequestValidator validator; readonly IEngineeringQueryNormalizer normalizer; readonly IEngineeringJobStore jobs; readonly IEngineeringCancellationRegistry cancellations; readonly ISafeEngineeringDiagnostics diagnostics;
    public EngineeringExecutionService(IEngineeringAdapterRegistry registry, IEngineeringRequestValidator validator, IEngineeringQueryNormalizer normalizer, IEngineeringJobStore jobs, IEngineeringCancellationRegistry cancellations, ISafeEngineeringDiagnostics diagnostics) { this.registry = registry; this.validator = validator; this.normalizer = normalizer; this.jobs = jobs; this.cancellations = cancellations; this.diagnostics = diagnostics; }
    public async Task<EngineeringDiscoveryResult> DiscoverAsync(EngineeringDiscoveryRequest request, CancellationToken token) { var valid = validator.Validate(request); if (!valid.IsValid) return new(request.SchemaVersion, request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, [new(request.RequestedSources.FirstOrDefault(), StandardStatus.Failed, Unsupported(request.RequestedSources.FirstOrDefault()), [], [], valid.Errors, false)], DateTimeOffset.UtcNow); QueryNormalizationRecord normalized; try { normalized = normalizer.Normalize(request.Query); } catch (EngineeringValidationException ex) { var err = new StructuredError(ex.Code, null, EngineeringStage.Validation, ex.Message, ex.Message, false, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow); return new(request.SchemaVersion, request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, [new(request.RequestedSources[0], StandardStatus.Failed, Unsupported(request.RequestedSources[0]), [], [], [err], false)], DateTimeOffset.UtcNow); } var results = new List<SourceDiscoveryOutcome>(); foreach (var source in request.RequestedSources) { if (!registry.TryResolve(source, out var adapter) || adapter is null) { var err = new StructuredError("source-adapter-not-implemented", source, EngineeringStage.Discovery, "The source adapter is not implemented.", "This source is not available in the current standardization slice.", false, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow); results.Add(new(source, StandardStatus.Unavailable, Unsupported(source), [], [], [err], false)); continue; } results.Add(await adapter.DiscoverAsync(request, normalized, token)); } return new(request.SchemaVersion, request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, results, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow); }
    public EngineeringJobRecord StartExtraction(EngineeringExtractionRequest request, CancellationToken requestToken) { var valid = validator.Validate(request); if (!valid.IsValid) throw new EngineeringValidationException(valid.Errors[0].Code, valid.Errors[0].UserMessage); if (!registry.TryResolve(request.Source, out var adapter) || adapter is null) throw new EngineeringValidationException("source-adapter-not-implemented", "The source adapter is not implemented."); var timeout = TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(request.TimeoutPolicy.TimeoutMs); var job = jobs.Create(request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, request.Source, timeout); var token = cancellations.Register(job.JobId, requestToken, timeout); _ = Task.Run(() => Run(job, request, adapter, token)); return job; }
    async Task Run(EngineeringJobRecord job, EngineeringExtractionRequest request, IEngineeringSourceAdapter adapter, CancellationToken token) { try { jobs.TryTransition(job.JobId, JobState.Extracting, EngineeringStage.Extraction, 1, "extraction-started"); var progress = new Progress<StandardProgress>(p => jobs.TryTransition(job.JobId, p.State, p.Stage, p.ProgressPercent, p.Message)); var result = await adapter.ExtractAsync(job.JobId, request, progress, token); var state = result.Status switch { StandardStatus.Success => JobState.Success, StandardStatus.PartialSuccess => JobState.PartialSuccess, StandardStatus.Empty => JobState.Empty, StandardStatus.Cancelled => JobState.Cancelled, StandardStatus.TimedOut => JobState.TimedOut, StandardStatus.Unavailable => JobState.Unavailable, _ => JobState.Failed }; jobs.TryTransition(job.JobId, state, result.Progress.Stage, 100, result.Progress.Message, result.Errors.FirstOrDefault(), result.Warnings.FirstOrDefault(), result); diagnostics.Event(request.RequestId, request.CorrelationId, job.JobId, request.Source, result.Progress.Stage, state.ToString(), result.DurationMs, errorCode: result.Errors.FirstOrDefault()?.Code); } catch (OperationCanceledException) { if (jobs.TryGet(job.JobId, out var current) && current is not null) { var timeout = cancellations.WasTimedOut(job.JobId); var state = timeout ? JobState.TimedOut : JobState.Cancelled; var stage = timeout ? EngineeringStage.Timeout : EngineeringStage.Cancellation; var code = timeout ? "source-timeout" : "source-cancelled"; var error = new StructuredError(code, request.Source, stage, timeout ? "Source execution timed out." : "Source execution was cancelled.", timeout ? "The source timed out." : "The source execution was cancelled.", timeout, DateTimeOffset.UtcNow); jobs.TryTransition(job.JobId, state, stage, 100, code, error); } } finally { cancellations.Complete(job.JobId); } }
static SourceCapability Unsupported(EngineeringSource source) => new(
    Source: source,
    Readiness: SourceReadiness.Unavailable,
    DiscoveryModes: [DiscoveryMode.Unsupported],
    SupportsExactId: false,
    SupportsNameSearch: false,
    SupportsNumberSearch: false,
    SupportsStructureExtraction: false,
    SupportsRevisionContext: false,
    SupportsChangeContext: false,
    SupportsRequirements: false,
    SupportsOperationalImpact: false,
    SupportsConfigurationContext: false,
    SupportsCancellation: false,
    SupportsRetry: false,
    SupportsPartialSuccess: false,
    RequiredOrganizationContext: [],
    KnownLimitations: ["Adapter not implemented in this slice."]
);
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\Orchestration.API\Engineering\Services\EngineeringJobStore.cs =====
using System.Collections.Concurrent;
using Orchestration.API.Engineering.Contracts;

namespace Orchestration.API.Engineering.Services;

public interface IEngineeringJobStore
{
    EngineeringJobRecord Create(string requestId, string correlationId, EngineeringSource source, TimeSpan timeout);
    bool TryGet(string jobId, out EngineeringJobRecord? job);
    bool TryGetResult(string jobId, out StandardExtractionResult? result);
    string LookupStatus(string jobId);
    bool TryTransition(string jobId, JobState state, EngineeringStage stage, int progress, string message, StructuredError? error = null, StructuredWarning? warning = null, StandardExtractionResult? result = null);
    int CleanupExpired(TimeSpan retention);
}

public sealed class EngineeringJobStore : IEngineeringJobStore
{
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, EngineeringJobRecord> jobs = new();
    private readonly ConcurrentDictionary<string, DateTimeOffset> expired = new();
    private static readonly HashSet<JobState> Terminal =
    [
        JobState.Success, JobState.PartialSuccess, JobState.Empty, JobState.Failed,
        JobState.Unavailable, JobState.Cancelled, JobState.TimedOut
    ];

    public EngineeringJobRecord Create(string requestId, string correlationId, EngineeringSource source, TimeSpan timeout)
    {
        var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
        var id = $"eng-{source.ToString().ToLowerInvariant()}-{Guid.NewGuid():N}";
        var job = new EngineeringJobRecord(id, requestId, correlationId, source, JobState.Accepted,
            EngineeringStage.Validation, 0, now, null, null, null, now + timeout, [], [], false, null,
            new("accepted", null, null, now));
        jobs[id] = job;
        return job;
    }

    public bool TryGet(string jobId, out EngineeringJobRecord? job) => jobs.TryGetValue(jobId, out job);

    public bool TryGetResult(string jobId, out StandardExtractionResult? result)
    {
        result = null;
        if (!jobs.TryGetValue(jobId, out var job) || !job.ResultAvailable || job.Result is null) return false;
        result = job.Result;
        return true;
    }

    public string LookupStatus(string jobId) => jobs.ContainsKey(jobId) ? "active" : expired.ContainsKey(jobId) ? "expired" : "unknown";

    public bool TryTransition(string id, JobState state, EngineeringStage stage, int progress, string message,
        StructuredError? error = null, StructuredWarning? warning = null, StandardExtractionResult? result = null)
    {
        while (jobs.TryGetValue(id, out var old))
        {
            // Adapters may report 100% success immediately before the execution service attaches
            // the final StandardExtractionResult. Permit only that same-terminal-state enrichment.
            var attachingResultToTerminalJob = Terminal.Contains(old.State) && result is not null &&
                                               old.Result is null && old.State == state;
            if (Terminal.Contains(old.State) && !attachingResultToTerminalJob) return false;
            if (state == JobState.Success && old.State is JobState.CancellationRequested or JobState.Cancelled or JobState.TimedOut) return false;
            if (progress < old.ProgressPercent) return false;

            var now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
            var warnings = old.Warnings.ToList();
            var errors = old.Errors.ToList();
            if (warning is not null && !warnings.Any(x => x.Code == warning.Code && x.OccurredAt == warning.OccurredAt)) warnings.Add(warning);
            if (error is not null && !errors.Any(x => x.Code == error.Code && x.OccurredAt == error.OccurredAt)) errors.Add(error);

            var next = old with
            {
                State = state,
                CurrentStage = stage,
                ProgressPercent = Math.Clamp(progress, 0, 100),
                StartedAt = old.StartedAt ?? now,
                CompletedAt = Terminal.Contains(state) ? old.CompletedAt ?? now : null,
                CancellationRequestedAt = state == JobState.CancellationRequested ? now : old.CancellationRequestedAt,
                Warnings = warnings,
                Errors = errors,
                ResultAvailable = result is not null || old.ResultAvailable,
                Result = result ?? old.Result,
                Diagnostic = new(message, warning?.Code, error?.Code, now)
            };
            if (jobs.TryUpdate(id, next, old)) return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public int CleanupExpired(TimeSpan retention)
    {
        var cutoff = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow - retention;
        var count = 0;
        foreach (var entry in jobs)
        {
            if (entry.Value.CompletedAt is { } completedAt && completedAt < cutoff && jobs.TryRemove(entry.Key, out _))
            {
                expired[entry.Key] = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }
}


===== FILE: .\OrchestrationPlatform\Orchestration.API\Engineering\Services\EngineeringQueryNormalizer.cs =====
using Orchestration.API.Engineering.Contracts;
namespace Orchestration.API.Engineering.Services;
public interface IEngineeringQueryNormalizer { QueryNormalizationRecord Normalize(EngineeringQuery query); NormalizedEngineeringQuery NormalizeFederated(EngineeringQuery query); }
public sealed class EngineeringQueryNormalizer : IEngineeringQueryNormalizer {
 public const int MaximumLength=256;
 public QueryNormalizationRecord Normalize(EngineeringQuery query) {
  var original=query.OriginalInput ?? query.ProductId ?? query.ProductName ?? "";
  if(original.Length>MaximumLength) throw new EngineeringValidationException("query-too-long","Query exceeds the maximum length.");
  if(original.Any(c=>char.IsControl(c) && c is not '\t' and not '\r' and not '\n')) throw new EngineeringValidationException("query-control-character","Query contains an unsupported control character.");
  var normalized=original.Trim(); var steps=new List<string>();
  if(!string.Equals(original,normalized,StringComparison.Ordinal)) steps.Add("trim-surrounding-whitespace");
  if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(normalized)) throw new EngineeringValidationException("query-empty","A product ID, product name, or original input is required.");
  var inferred=query.IdentifierType; var confidence=ConfidenceClass.Unverified;
  if(inferred==IdentifierType.Auto) { if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.ProductId)){inferred=IdentifierType.ProductId;confidence=ConfidenceClass.Probable;} else if(!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(query.ProductName)){inferred=IdentifierType.ProductName;confidence=ConfidenceClass.Probable;} }
  return new(original,normalized,steps,Array.Empty<StructuredWarning>(),inferred,confidence);
 }
 public NormalizedEngineeringQuery NormalizeFederated(EngineeringQuery query) {
  var original=query.OriginalInput?.Trim();
  var id=Field(query.ProductId); var name=Field(query.ProductName);
  if(id.NormalizedValue is null && name.NormalizedValue is null && string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(original)) throw new EngineeringValidationException("query-empty","A product ID, product name, or original input is required.");
  if((query.ProductId?.Length??0)>MaximumLength||(query.ProductName?.Length??0)>MaximumLength||(query.OriginalInput?.Length??0)>MaximumLength) throw new EngineeringValidationException("query-too-long","Query exceeds the maximum length.");
  foreach(var value in new[]{query.ProductId,query.ProductName,query.OriginalInput}) if(value?.Any(c=>char.IsControl(c) && c is not '\t' and not '\r' and not '\n')==true) throw new EngineeringValidationException("query-control-character","Query contains an unsupported control character.");
  var type=query.IdentifierType==IdentifierType.Auto?(id.NormalizedValue is not null?IdentifierType.ProductId:IdentifierType.ProductName):query.IdentifierType;
  return new(query.OriginalInput,id,name,type,query.Revision,query.Version,Array.Empty<StructuredWarning>());
 }
 static NormalizedQueryField Field(string? value){if(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(value))return new(value,null,Array.Empty<string>());var trimmed=value.Trim();return new(value,trimmed,string.Equals(value,trimmed,StringComparison.Ordinal)?Array.Empty<string>():new[]{"trim-surrounding-whitespace"});}

}
public sealed class EngineeringValidationException : Exception { public string Code {get;} public EngineeringValidationException(string code,string message):base(message){Code=code;} }
